The Team:

The Enterprise Architect - Finance will design, govern, and lead the strategic architecture for all critical financial, billing ,revenue and legal systems across the enterprise including core ERP platforms (Oracle NetSuite and Oracle Fusion Cloud) , Financial Planning & Analysis , and Procurement (Coupa) . This role is instrumental in driving the company’s financial transformation, operational scalability, and modernization initiatives , ensuring seamless system integration, data integrity, compliance, and long-term sustainability. Additionally, the position leads the integration of agentic AI capabilities and advanced AI frameworks into financial workflows to automate processes and unlock operational efficiencies.

The ideal candidate will combine deep technical and architectural expertise with strong business acumen to shape a cohesive, cloud-first ecosystem that empowers Finance, Legal, and Business stakeholders to achieve strategic goals efficiently and effectively.

The Opportunity:

Strategic Architecture & Roadmapping

• Oracle NetSuite & Fusion Cloud: Lead SuiteSuccess design, advanced module integration, SuiteScript coding standards, multi-subsidiary enterprise architecture, EPM (Planning & FCCS), data migration initiatives, and OCI security frameworks.

• Expert knowledge of enterprise integration frameworks and technologies: SuiteScript/JavaScript, Python, API orchestration, AI MCP, and Agent event-driven architectures

• Strong foundation in data modeling, master data management (MDM) , and metadata governance.

• Familiarity with data warehousing, BI tools, and analytics platforms supporting financial and operational reporting.

• Exposure to Enterprise Architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman) and architecture tooling (LeanIX, Lucidchart, etc.).

Education

To learn more about Okta, visit: https://www.okta.com .

The Opportunity

We are in search of a top tier Payroll Accountant to join our Compensation GL team. The ideal candidate is a detailed-oriented, self-motivated team player, who enjoys working in a challenging and fast-paced environment. This individual should have a solid working knowledge of GAAP, SEC regulations, and internal controls and will be responsible for the timely and accurate recording of compensation and benefits related activities of the company.

Additionally, this role will be responsible for supporting the month-end close process, SOX compliance control execution and quarterly / annual audit process, as well as identifying and driving project-based work to provide process efficiencies for the team. This role will be reporting to the International Compensation Accounting Manager.

What you’ll be doing

• Perform various GL month-end close activities for the Okta International entities, including preparation of journal entries and balance sheet reconciliations

• Support monthly and semi-monthly payroll cycles with the recording of needed journal entries

• Prepare journal entries for cash accounts and perform reconciliation on a regular basis

• Responsible for the preparation of the vacation accruals for the Okta International Entities

• Prepare month-end closing journal entries, including resolving discrepancies and ensuring entries are in accordance with US GAAP, IFRS, FRS and Local GAAP

• Prepare P&L and Balance Sheet fluctuation analyses

• Assist in implementing new accounting policies, controls and procedures

• Ensure SOX and policy compliance

• Assist in preparing internal and external financial reporting schedules

• Provide a high level of customer service with finance and non-finance business partners

• Maintain strong and productive relationships with People team, including Benefits, Operations, Finance, Stock Admin, Legal and other internal stakeholders

• Support the quarterly reviews and annual audit requests and inquiries from our external auditors

• Ad hoc accounting projects and requests, as needed

What you’ll bring to the role

• Bachelor’s degree, with an emphasis in Accounting or Finance

• 2-4 years of combined public accounting and private industry at a publicly traded company

• Certified Accountant (CA) or CA candidate a plus

• Experience with the operations and related accounting for payroll, cash, bonus, and commissions.

• Knowledge of deferred commissions and stock-based compensation would be beneficial

• Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Powerpoint)

• Experience with Google Suite preferred

• Experience with NetSuite preferred, or related accounting software

• Experience using Workday, ADP, SafeGuard or other comparable payroll software a plus

• Knowledge and application of US GAAP, IFRS, FRS, Local GAAP, SEC regulations, and SOX/internal controls

• Strong problem solving, analytical, and organizational skills

• Ability to identify, follow-up and resolve discrepancies timely

• Strong attention to detail

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal

• Strong team player, who builds positive work relationships across the organization

• Ability to adhere to deadlines in a fast-paced environment, without sacrificing accuracy

• Strong systems knowledge, including the ability to quickly learn new systems

Reporting to the Director of People Technology, this role will serve as a Delivery Lead and Principal Product Analyst for Okta's People Technology portfolio, focused on the Growth & Talent pod. In this broad role, you will lead complex, multi-system initiatives spanning Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Performance, Learning, and Career Development. Strategic Leadership: Technically scope and lead the delivery of multi-quarter, high-visibility, executive-sponsored projects across the Growth & Talent ecosystem (e.g., Greenhouse ATS integration & workflows, Cornerstone L&D platform optimization, and Workday Talent & Performance solutions).

opportunities.title: Business Systems Analyst 3
opportunities.description:
We are seeking an experienced, techno-functional Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with broad experience across enterprise finance systems and processes, including accounting, Order-to-Cash (OTC), Source-to-Pay (S2P), and Procure-to-Pay (P2P). The ideal candidate will bridge business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver system enhancements, integrations, automation, and process improvements across the finance function. The role requires an understanding of end-to-end finance processes, requirements gathering, functional configuration, integration design, testing, production support, and stakeholder management.

1. Business Analysis and Process Management

• Partner with Procurement, Accounts Payable, Finance, and business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements

• Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and solution designs

• Analyze and optimize end-to-end finance processes, including general ledger, record-to-report, accounts payable, accounts receivable, Order-to-Cash (OTC), Source-to-Pay (S2P), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), billing, collections, reconciliations, and financial close

• Conduct fit-gap analysis and recommend scalable solutions aligned with business and compliance requirements

• Facilitate stakeholder workshops, requirement reviews, and solution walkthroughs

2. Integrations and Technical Collaboration

• Work with integration developers to define interface requirements, data mappings, transformation rules, and error-handling mechanisms

• Support integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP, flat files, and middleware or iPaaS platforms

• Analyze integration failures, data discrepancies, synchronization issues, and transaction errors

• Document interface specifications, field mappings, dependencies, and reconciliation procedures

• Collaborate with ERP teams, particularly NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle, to support financial postings and master data synchronization

3. Testing, Deployment, and Production Support

• Develop test scenarios, test cases, and test data for system enhancements and integrations

• Execute functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT)

• Coordinate defect triage, root cause analysis, and resolution with technical teams

• Support release management, deployment validation, and post-implementation stabilization

• Maintain functional documentation, configuration records, support procedures, and knowledge articles

4. Governance, Controls, and Stakeholder Management

• Ensure solutions align with internal controls, audit requirements, segregation of duties, and financial compliance standards

• Support access reviews, approval hierarchy validation, and audit evidence collection

• Manage incidents, service requests, and enhancement backlogs using tools such as Jira or ServiceNow

• Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and resolutions to business and technical stakeholders

• Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and continuous process improvement

Required Qualifications and Skills

• 6+ years of experience in business systems analysis, enterprise applications, or finance systems

• Strong techno-functional experience with enterprise finance systems

• Good understanding of core finance and accounting processes, such as general ledger, record-to-report, accounts payable, accounts receivable, Order-to-Cash (OTC), Source-to-Pay (S2P), Procure-to Pay (P2P), billing, collections, reconciliations, and financial close

• Experience gathering requirements and creating functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and solution documentation

• Practical understanding of APIs, integration patterns, data mapping, file-based interfaces, and troubleshooting

• Experience with functional testing, UAT coordination, defect management, and production support

• Familiarity with Finance systems such as NetSuite, Concur, COUPA etc

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills

• Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with business users, developers, and integration teams

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with finance systems integrations involving ERP, CRM, billing, HR, banking, procurement, and other business platforms

• Familiarity with SQL, data analysis, API testing tools such as Postman, and integration monitoring

• Experience supporting multi-entity, multi-subsidiary, or global finance environments

• Knowledge of SOX controls, audit requirements, approval governance, and financial reconciliations

• Experience with Agile delivery, Jira, ServiceNow, and ITIL-based support processes

Key Success Criteria

• Accurate translation of business requirements into effective system solutions

• Reliable operation of finance systems business processes and integrations

• Reduced transaction errors, integration failures, and manual intervention

• Timely resolution of production issues and delivery of system enhancements

• Improved user experience, process efficiency, compliance, and audit readines

opportunities.description:
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database , preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.

To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.

As a Forward Deployed Architect in our ISV Practice, you will be the technical design lead for engagements with independent software vendors (ISVs). You will work with ISV development leaders, senior engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to design how MongoDB integrates with and extends the partner’s product.

This is an application architecture role, not a database administration or database consulting role. You will ensure that the designs implemented by the team are practical, production-ready, and reusable across future partner engagements.

Learn more about #LifeAtMongoDB here !

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

What you’ll do at MongoDB

• Lead technical design for ISV engagements by understanding partner architecture and delivery models, then defining MongoDB data models, access patterns, indexing, and integration approaches for products serving different industries

• Design MongoDB as a supported platform option alongside Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server, including persistence abstractions, feature parity, backend-specific behavior, and certification requirements

• Design coexistence architectures and migration paths, including data flows, synchronization, consistency, application refactoring, dual-run strategies, validation, and controlled cutover

• Lead design reviews, provide technical direction, and review schemas, queries, indexes, MongoDB-related code, and performance against realistic partner workloads

• Design solutions across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or air-gapped on-premises environments

• Build reusable architecture patterns, migration playbooks, code templates, decision frameworks, and other assets that make future partner engagements faster and more consistent

• Stay hands-on by reading partner code and prototyping critical paths, act as the technical escalation point for Forward Deployed Engineers, and share recurring technical gaps and patterns with MongoDB Product and Engineering teams

As an ideal candidate, you will have

• 8+ years of experience in backend engineering and application architecture, delivering production software products

• Strong application-side MongoDB expertise, including access-pattern-driven data modeling, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, replication, sharding, and sizing

• Application-level experience with at least one major relational database and integrating a new database into a large production codebase, including persistence abstraction, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, transactional boundaries, and incremental rollout

• Experience designing migrations of production workloads between relational databases and MongoDB

• Strong SaaS and product-engineering knowledge, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, backward compatibility, and managed-cloud, Kubernetes-based private-cloud, or self-managed on-premises deployments

• The ability to influence engineers and stakeholders without formal authority through technically sound, practical designs; explain trade-offs clearly; identify risks early; and balance delivery speed, quality, and long-term maintainability

• Willingness to travel regularly to ISV partner locations

As an ideal candidate, you may also have

• Experience working inside an ISV or product company, including in a forward-deployed, resident-architect, embedded-architect, or similar technical delivery role

• Familiarity with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka or Debezium

• Experience with regulated or data-intensive industries and their security, compliance, and data-governance requirements

• MongoDB certification, MongoDB Atlas experience, or experience with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio

What you will learn

• Deepen your expertise across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, application development, data modeling, search, vector workloads, and the broader MongoDB ecosystem

• Develop advanced experience in multi-database application architecture, database coexistence, migrations, cloud-native deployment, and the operational considerations of partner products

opportunities.description:

Role Overview

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

Responsibilities

• Translate business requirements into scalable marketing technology and Salesforce solutions using declarative configuration, custom development, APIs, and integration platforms

Marketing Technology Engineering

• Own and enhance capabilities across:

• Lead capture, conversion, qualification, and routing

• Marketing enrichment and data normalization

• Campaign and campaign member management

• Account identification, matching, and hierarchy management

• Territory planning and account assignment

• Activity and engagement management

• Outreach and business development workflows

• Marketing attribution and lifecycle reporting

• Annual planning and operational planning processes

Integration and System Design

• Design and support secure, reliable, and observable inbound and outbound integrations across Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, and enterprise platforms

• Establish reliable data flows and controls that improve completeness, accuracy, consistency, deduplication, consent handling, and governance across lead, contact, account, campaign, and activity data

Engineering Excellence

• Maintain high standards for modular design, test coverage, documentation, deployment processes, monitoring, CI/CD, and adherence to shared integration and Salesforce engineering patterns

Platform Optimization

• Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, integration risks, manual processes, technical debt, and opportunities to simplify the marketing technology architecture

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

• 4+ years of hands-on Salesforce development or enterprise business systems engineering experience

• Strong experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, and platform automation

• Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python and JavaScript, with experience building reusable automation, data transformation, and integration services

• Experience with React or comparable modern front-end frameworks

• Experience with full-stack development, including front-end applications, back-end services, APIs, data models, authentication, testing, deployment, and operational support

• Experience designing and supporting marketing technology, CRM, lead management, or revenue operations solutions

• Experience building and supporting REST or SOAP API integrations and data synchronization processes

• Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, data quality, and scalable implementation practices

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills

opportunities.title: Account Executive, Commercial & SMB (India)
opportunities.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

India is home to a large and rapidly evolving base of digital businesses. SaaS companies, e-commerce businesses, platforms, marketplaces, and AI-first companies are scaling quickly, serving increasingly sophisticated customers, and expanding beyond India.

Stripe’s Commercial & SMB team partners with high-potential businesses at an important stage of their growth. Some are already using Stripe and can benefit from a deeper partnership. Others are evaluating how to modernize their payments and financial infrastructure. Our role is to understand their ambitions, help them make well-informed decisions, and bring together the right capabilities across Stripe.

This is a full-cycle sales role with meaningful ownership. You will create pipeline, win new users, expand existing relationships, and help shape Stripe’s commercial strategy in India. You will join a focused, entrepreneurial team in Bengaluru while working closely with colleagues across Stripe’s global Product, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Risk, Legal, Finance, and Operations organizations.

What you’ll do

You will own a portfolio of high-potential commercial and small-to-medium businesses across India. You will operate with a dual mandate: acquire new users and grow existing relationships through greater adoption, new use cases, and long-term strategic value.

Responsibilities

• Build and execute a territory plan focused on high-potential Indian SaaS companies, digital-native businesses, e-commerce companies, platforms, marketplaces, and global-first businesses

• Generate your own pipeline through thoughtful outbound engagement, referrals, ecosystem relationships, events, partnerships, and rigorous account research

• Lead the complete sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through solution design, commercial negotiation, contracting, and launch

• Develop trusted relationships with founders and senior stakeholders across finance, product, engineering, operations, and procurement

• Understand each user’s business model, growth priorities, technical architecture, and current financial infrastructure

• Translate complex customer needs into clear solutions and business cases, connecting Stripe’s capabilities to measurable outcomes

• Identify opportunities for new product adoption, deeper integrations, improved payment performance, new business models, and international expansion

• Lead compelling product and solution conversations in partnership with Solutions Architecture and other specialists

• Navigate multi-stakeholder decisions involving commercial, technical, operational, risk, and regulatory considerations

• Negotiate pricing and commercial terms with sound judgment, balancing user value, competitive context, and Stripe’s long-term objectives

• Manage pipeline and forecasting with rigor, using data to prioritize accounts and maintain a clear view of risks, dependencies, and next steps

• Partner with Customer Success and cross-functional teams to ensure a strong transition from sale to implementation and long-term adoption

• Bring structured market and user feedback to Stripe’s Product, Marketing, and leadership teams

• Represent Stripe in India’s technology and business ecosystem, building relationships with founders, investors, accelerators, partners, and industry communities

What success looks like

In this role, success means:

• Creating a healthy, self-generated pipeline in priority segments

• Winning high-quality new users and expanding existing relationships

• Increasing adoption of relevant Stripe products and use cases

• Building senior relationships that position Stripe as a long-term strategic partner

• Running disciplined sales cycles with clear qualification, strong business cases, accurate forecasting, and effective close plans

• Helping Stripe develop a sharper understanding of India’s commercial and SMB opportunity

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 7+ years of experience in full-cycle, consultative B2B technology sales, including meaningful experience in the Indian market

• A demonstrated track record of generating pipeline and closing new-business or expansion opportunities

• Experience selling to founders or senior stakeholders across finance, product, technology, or operations

• Strong discovery, qualification, and solution-selling skills

• Ability to understand technical products and translate complex requirements into clear customer and business value

• Strong commercial judgment, including experience building business cases and leading pricing and contract negotiations

• Analytical discipline and comfort using data to prioritize a territory, assess opportunities, and forecast accurately

• Ability to manage multiple sales cycles at different stages without compromising quality or customer trust

• Experience coordinating complex work across multiple internal teams

• Ability to operate with ownership, resilience, and sound judgment in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

Preferred Qualifications

Your work will include processing supplier invoices in Oracle, managing invoice backlogs, and resolving queries from suppliers and internal teams. You’ll partner with Procurement, Vendor Management, Payments, and Accounting to resolve issues and keep payments on track.

You’ll also lead cross-functional automation and process improvement projects to reduce manual work, improve invoice accuracy, shorten processing times, and make it easier for teams to track invoices and queries. As workflows change, you’ll update standard operating procedures and communicate those changes to the teams that rely on them.

Responsibilities

• Own invoice processing and AP query management for US and international entities. Become a subject matter expert in the end-to-end procure-to-pay process and related activities.

• Process a high volume of supplier invoices in Oracle. Validate invoice details and accounting coding, prioritize invoices by due date and urgency, and meet accuracy and turnaround targets.

• Own supplier and internal AP queries from intake through resolution. Investigate invoice discrepancies, holds, potential duplicates, approval delays, and payment-status questions. Keep stakeholders informed and follow up until each issue is resolved.

Who you are

You understand the end-to-end procure-to-pay process and have hands-on experience processing a high volume of supplier invoices in Oracle or a comparable ERP. You manage competing deadlines and invoice backlogs without sacrificing accuracy, and you’ve owned supplier and internal AP queries from intake through resolution. You bring a strong accounting foundation, including general ledger processes, the chart of accounts, account coding, reconciliations, and month-end close. You exercise sound judgment and discretion, apply internal controls and compliance policies consistently, and know when to escalate an issue. • 6–8 years of relevant accounts payable experience, preferably at a large multinational or global company, with hands-on experience processing high volumes of supplier invoices and resolving AP queries.

• Strong understanding of accounting concepts, including accruals, prepayments, and the chart of accounts.

• Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, with experience analyzing large datasets to investigate discrepancies and make sound decisions.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to stay organized while managing competing priorities.

• Demonstrated ability to partner with cross-functional teams and follow issues through to resolution.

• Ability to work independently, take initiative, and deliver accurate results with minimal supervision.

• A proactive, detail-oriented approach to solving problems and improving processes.

You will also likely have (not required):

• Experience working at a high-growth technology or financial services company

• Experience with Oracle, Zip, or similar enterprise resource planning (ERP), accounting, or procurement systems.

• knowledge on India TDS/GST/e-invoicing would be an add on.

What you’ll do

Workday operations

• Monitor the Workday inbox for business process errors, stuck transactions, alerts, and other operational issues.

• Support year-end activity, including schedule extensions, alert configuration, audit requests, and tracking follow-up items.

• Support recurring People programs, such as performance-cycle launches, using established runbooks and checklists.

Reporting, documentation, and Jira support

• Intake and triage Workday reporting and data requests. Confirm required information, route requests to the right owner, and provide status updates to requesters.

• Complete standard reporting tasks and access-related requests where there is a documented process and appropriate approval.

• Maintain runbooks, Trailhead content, standard operating procedures, and request templates so guidance stays current and easy to find.

• Support data-quality checks and follow established processes to correct or escalate issues.

Partnership with People Systems

• Work closely with People Systems analysts and engineers to understand support priorities, upcoming releases, recurring work, and escalation paths.

• Provide clear handoffs for work that requires configuration changes, advanced reporting, integrations, security decisions, or policy interpretation.

• Participate in regular reviews of queue trends, service levels, documentation gaps, and operational risks.

• Build platform knowledge over time, with opportunities to take on more complex administration and configuration work as skills develop.

Minimum requirements

• Experience in People operations, HR administration, systems support, service delivery, or another operations role involving high-volume, process-driven work.

• Strong attention to detail, particularly where accuracy affects People records, access, payroll, compliance, or reporting.

• Ability to work through a queue independently, prioritize requests, follow defined processes, and escalate issues at the right time.

• Clear written communication and comfort giving requesters concise status updates.

• Experience using Jira, Salesforce, or a similar case-management or ticketing tool.

• Comfort learning enterprise systems and following structured procedures across multiple tools.

• Strong organization skills and a consistent approach to documenting work and following requests through to resolution.

• Good judgment when working with confidential information.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience supporting Workday, including Core HCM, business processes, security administration, reporting, or Workday inbox monitoring.

• Experience handling reporting requests, data access requests, and standard user provisioning.

• Experience supporting cyclical People programs, compliance activities, audit requests, or system-release testing.

Within the first six months, you will:

• Own the defined tier 1 and routine tier 2 People Systems queue work with accurate, timely resolution and clear escalation.

• Establish dependable monitoring for People Systems tickets in Salesforce, JIRA, the Workday inbox, and recurring operational tasks.

• Reduce avoidable handoffs and ensure complex work reaches the right People Systems owner with the context needed to act.

• Keep core runbooks and self-service guidance current based on recurring request patterns.

• Give People Systems analysts and engineers more capacity for configuration, governance, architecture, and strategic delivery work.

• 12+ years of relevant India tax experience in a Big 4 firm, law firm and/or multinational organisation, with demonstrated ownership of complex tax matters.

• A professional qualification such as Chartered Accountant, lawyer or equivalent, and deep technical knowledge of Indian corporate and indirect tax law.

• Significant hands-on experience leading India tax audits, assessments, appeals or litigation, including developing controversy strategy and engaging with tax authorities and advisers.

‘Nice to have’ really means ‘nice to have’. It’s completely possible that you don’t have any of these and are still a great fit for the team.

opportunities.title: Applied Scientist III
opportunities.description:
InMobi (Corporate)

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

InMobi Advertising

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

Glance

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

Overview of the role:

We are looking for an Applied Scientist III to join our algorithmic and research science team. You'll work on mathematically rigorous, research-driven problems at production scale, while owning problems end to end. This role sits at the intersection of theory and application, designing algorithms that combine elegant modeling with measurable business impact. Specifically, our scientists tackle challenges across traffic shaping, fraud detection, ad quality, pricing strategies, and auction theory, along with their practical applications. We leverage the latest deep learning models alongside classical machine learning techniques to build innovative solutions.

As the heart of the InMobi Exchange, our team optimizes the company's core business functions and creates the strategic moat that sets us apart in the market. As an Applied Scientist, you will not just "use models"—you will formulate them, evaluate their assumptions, tailor them to our problem domain, and bring them to life in production. Many of our challenges have no off-the-shelf solutions; we require scientific creativity to bridge research and reality.

If you thrive on solving complex, high-impact problems and want to see your ideas shape the future of a global exchange, this is the place where your work will truly make a difference.

The impact you'll make:

• Formulate, analyze, and implement algorithms that power real-time auctions, dynamic pricing, bid shaping, pacing, and traffic allocation across a massive-scale ad marketplace.

• Design and experiment with methods in online learning, reinforcement learning, multi-armed bandits, forecasting, game theory, and Bayesian modeling—in non-stationary, adversarial environments.

• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deploy your models in production and run real-world experiments with rapid feedback loops (measured in hours, not weeks).

• Participate in scientific design reviews and contribute to raising the methodological bar of the team.

• Contribute to the scientific community by publishing high-quality research, conducting internal seminars, and staying abreast of advances in machine learning, algorithms, and applied statistics.

• Evaluate the long-term dynamics of deployed algorithms, incorporating feedback, exploitation-exploration trade-offs, and incentives within multi-agent systems.

• Help identify new areas for innovation by translating business challenges into research questions and proposing novel, high-impact methodologies.

• Translate mathematical ideas into practical, high-performance algorithms that operate at scale in production environments.

• Explore and close the loop between model predictions and real-world outcomes, refining algorithms based on system behavior.

The experience we need:

• A Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Physics, or a related quantitative discipline is strongly preferred. A degree is not a hard requirement—demonstrated research depth and production impact count.

• 4–7 years of experience working on algorithmic or applied research problems, including significant production deployment experience. Candidates with more or less experience are welcome to apply—we hire across Applied Scientist II, Applied Scientist III, and Staff Applied Scientist levels.

• Deep grounding in one or more of:

• Statistical learning theory, mathematical optimization, discrete algorithms, probability theory, and information theory

• Causal inference, decision theory, game theory, auction theory

• Online learning, bandits, RL, Bayesian methods

• Strong publication record (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, AISTATS, KDD, UAI, WSDM, EC, SODA, COLT) is a strong plus—even if not recent.

• Proficient in scientific computing with Python, including packages such as NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.

• Comfortable working with big data platforms like Apache Spark, distributed computing, and large-scale datasets.

• A researcher's mindset: questions first, implementation later. You are thoughtful about assumptions and rigorous about validation.

• End-to-end ownership: you can go from idea to production and thrive in applied settings.

Prior experience in ad tech, marketplaces, or dynamic pricing is helpful but not required.

Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.

If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.

Find out more here: InMobi Culture

About the Team

At InMobi, we're reimagining how Inside Sales operates by bringing together AI agents, market intelligence, and human sales expertise.

Our Agentic Inside Sales Organization (ISO) is being built as a dedicated revenue engine to drive new business across non-enterprise and mid-market advertisers, brands, agencies, and publishers globally, with a strong focus on North America.

Unlike traditional Inside Sales, where sellers spend significant time researching accounts, prospecting, and managing outbound sequences, our AI agents handle much of this work. This allows our sellers to focus on what matters most: engaging customers, building relationships, closing deals, and accelerating revenue growth.

We're looking for an ambitious, commercially driven sales leader who combines a strong hunter mindset with a genuine interest in AI, automation, and building the next generation of sales workflows.

What Will You Be Doing?

As Lead – Agentic Inside Sales , you will own non-enterprise revenue growth across InMobi and Glance, working across both Demand and Supply businesses.

You will operate as an AI-enabled sales leader, managing intelligent agents that support account discovery, research, prospecting, and personalized outreach, while taking direct ownership of qualified opportunities, client engagement, negotiations, and closures.

• Own Revenue Growth & Deal Closures

• Own and consistently achieve or exceed revenue OKRs across assigned global markets, predominantly North America.

• Drive new business acquisition across advertisers, brands, agencies, and publishers within the non-enterprise and mid-market segments.

• Lead the end-to-end sales cycle from qualified opportunity to commercial negotiation, contracting, and closure.

• Build and manage a healthy pipeline with a strong focus on conversion, deal velocity, and contracted revenue.

• Identify opportunities to convert existing Open Exchange (OX) advertisers into Private Exchange (PX) partnerships, alongside new managed-service and supply partnerships.

• Lead an AI-First Sales Motion

• Manage AI sales colleagues as an extension of your sales team , overseeing automated account research, prospect identification, enrichment, and hyper-personalized 1:1 outreach.

• Work closely with AIBDR/GTM Engineering to continuously improve agent workflows, prompts, qualification logic, and outreach effectiveness.

• Translate business priorities into actionable AI-led demand programs across industries, markets, and customer segments.

• Monitor agent performance, prospect engagement, and pipeline conversion to optimize outcomes.

• Identify opportunities to automate repetitive sales processes, allowing greater focus on customer conversations and closures.

• Build & Expand Global Non-Enterprise Business

• Identify high-potential accounts and untapped revenue opportunities across Demand and Supply.

• Develop and expand a portfolio of non-enterprise and mid-market accounts across priority regions.

• Build relationships with decision-makers and key stakeholders, understanding their business challenges and positioning relevant InMobi and Glance solutions.

• Drive opportunities across programmatic advertising, performance marketing, omnichannel advertising, and publisher monetization.

• Collaborate with regional revenue teams to ensure alignment on account ownership, market priorities, and revenue opportunities.

• Drive Sales Execution & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Lead customer meetings, discovery discussions, product demonstrations, commercial negotiations, and deal closures.

• Work closely with Client Solutions, Account Management, Product, Engineering, Sales Planning, Audience Planning, Creative, and Legal teams.

• Translate customer requirements into commercially viable solutions, proposals, and media plans.

• Ensure seamless handover of closed opportunities to account management and revenue delivery teams.

• Maintain strong Salesforce hygiene, accurate revenue forecasts, and visibility into pipeline progression.

What We Require From You

• 6+ years of experience in Sales, Business Development, or Inside Sales, preferably within AdTech, programmatic advertising, digital media, or SaaS.

• Proven track record of independently managing revenue targets and closing new business.

• Strong hunter mentality with the ability to identify opportunities, negotiate effectively, and drive deals to closure.

• Experience working with North American customers and managing international business relationships.

• Strong understanding of digital advertising, programmatic ecosystems, DSPs, SSPs, and publisher monetization.

• AI-first mindset , with enthusiasm for adopting AI agents, automation platforms, and intelligent sales workflows.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, evolving business environment.

• MBA preferred, but not mandatory.

What Will Make You Stand Out?

• Hands-on experience using AI tools, sales automation platforms, or agentic workflows to improve sales productivity.

• Familiarity with AI-powered prospecting, CRM automation, prompt engineering, or workflow orchestration tools such as CrewAI, n8n, Apollo, or similar platforms.

• Experience building or scaling Inside Sales functions, particularly for SMB and mid-market customers.

• Strong understanding of both advertiser acquisition and publisher/supply partnerships.

• Experience converting programmatic Open Exchange relationships into curated deals or Private Exchange opportunities.

• Ability to think beyond traditional sales processes and identify opportunities where AI can improve efficiency, coverage, and revenue outcomes.

• Experience mentoring sales colleagues or leading small, high-performing teams.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured by business outcomes, not the number of emails sent or leads generated.

• Revenue Growth: Consistently achieving revenue OKRs and growing contracted revenue.

• Client Acquisition: Converting new non-enterprise and mid-market accounts into revenue-generating customers.

• Pipeline Velocity: Improving opportunity progression, sales-cycle efficiency, and deal conversion.

• Market Expansion: Unlocking revenue from untapped accounts, segments, and geographies.

• Agent Productivity: Scaling prospect coverage and qualified opportunities through effective management of AI agents.

• Customer Relationships: Building strong relationships that lead to repeat business and long-term growth.

Why Join Us?

This is not a traditional Inside Sales role.

You'll be among the early leaders shaping an AI-first sales organization , where intelligent agents handle much of the research and outreach while you focus on high-value customer engagement and revenue generation.

You'll have the opportunity to help build a new operating model for global sales, influence how AI agents are deployed, and directly contribute to scaling InMobi and Glance's non-enterprise business.

If you're a strong sales closer who enjoys technology, thrives on ambitious revenue targets, and believes AI can fundamentally change how sales teams operate, we'd love to hear from you.

Brief Description:

The Lead – Dealdesk will serve as the GTM Operations triage lead for InMobi Exchange, bridging business and operations across time zones. This role partners closely with Sales, Client Development, Agency Development, PTD, DPM, and product teams to drive real-time campaign and deal operations, ensuring flawless execution, same-day triage, and data-driven insight delivery.

This is a demand-heavy role focused on PMP deal analysis, campaign health monitoring, and RFP triage, while also acting as a quality and process gatekeeper. The ideal candidate combines deep adtech expertise, operational excellence, and strong analytical rigor to drive execution efficiency, elevate campaign outcomes, and close feedback loops between GTM and Central Ops.

Key Responsibilities:

• Review, evaluate, and approve complex and non-standard deals across PMPs based campaigns, strategic partnerships, and enterprise agreements.

• Ensure pricing, margins, discounts, rebates, and incentives align with company guardrails.

• Drive consistency in deal frameworks across regions and business units.

• Partner closely with Sales to structure strategic deals that balance revenue growth and profitability.

• Work with RevOps to ensure accurate documentation and system alignment (SFDC, BI tools, pricing trackers).

• Interface with Product and Operations for feasibility validation and operational impact assessment.

• Conduct deal-level P&L analysis including margin, cost allocation, rebates, tech fees, and platform costs.

• Model revenue scenarios and long-term account value.

• Identify revenue leakage risks and ensure proper controls.

• Review historical performance data to inform deal decisions.

• Define and continuously improve Deal Desk SOPs and approval workflows.

• Reduce deal scale turnaround time (TAT) without compromising governance.

• Implement deal approval matrices and automated workflows in SFDC.

• Maintain clean documentation and audit trails for compliance.

• Establish standardized pricing templates and commercial playbooks.

• Track discount trends, margin erosion, exception frequency, and revenue impact.

• Provide regular reporting to leadership on deal quality and profitability metrics.

• Identify patterns in pricing pressure and propose a corrective strategy.

• Drive data-backed commercial decision-making.

• Foster a culture of disciplined, data-driven deal execution.

• 6+ years of experience in programmatic operations, campaign management, or ad operations, preferably with global adtech exposure.

• Strong expertise in PMPs, Private Auctions, Brand IOs, and campaign setup workflows across DSPs (DV360, TTD, Xandr, Beeswax).

• Advanced proficiency in Excel, SQL, and BI/reporting tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).

• Demonstrated ability to analyze campaign data, detect anomalies, and communicate insights effectively.

• Strong grasp of creative QA, pacing, inclusion logic, and deal health optimization.

• Excellent stakeholder management across Sales, CSMs, Product, and HQ Ops teams.

• Ability to work across multiple time zones and ensure operational continuity between North America and India HQ.

• Proven track record in mentoring, training, and enabling new hires in ad operations or analytics.

• High attention to detail, a structured problem-solving approach, and a passion for operational excellence.

We like big challenges. Building a new company in 2007 was no ordinary task. As the recession hit, the iPhone was born and launched a revolution. Mobile advertising wasn’t yet a thing, other than SMS, and venture capital funding was hard to come by for four guys in India.

Yet with passion, foresight, and conviction – InMobi charted its own course, helping to transform the way consumers engage with their phones and create today's booming app economy wherein consumers now spend 4.2 hours per day.

After fourteen years of innovation, our end-to-end advertising software platform, connected content and commerce experiences have formed a powerful engine for growth that activates audiences, drives real connections, and diversifies revenue for companies around the world .

Our global organization of InMobians are excited to continue discovering and developing impactful technologies that will continue to transform people, businesses, and society.

Title: Manager - Executive Assistant

Position Summary:

We are looking for a highly experienced and proactive Executive Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative and strategic support to senior leadership. This is a high-visibility role that demands exceptional discretion, sharp organizational instincts, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, dynamic business environment.

The ideal candidate will bring at least 7-8 years of EA experience, ideally supporting C-suite or senior leadership, and will be comfortable managing competing priorities while maintaining confidentiality at all times. Experience working directly with Founders and/or CEOs is a strong advantage.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Calendar & Schedule Management

• Own and manage complex, multi-time zone calendars for one or more senior leaders

• Proactively anticipate and resolve scheduling conflicts

• Coordinate internal/external meetings, calls, and events across time zones and departments

2. Communication & Correspondence

• Draft, review, and manage professional correspondence and memos on behalf of leadership

• Act as primary point of contact — screening and triaging high-volume email and requests

• Liaise confidently with internal stakeholders, external partners, clients, and senior executives

3. Administrative & Operational Support

• Prepare, format, and organize reports, presentations, and business documents

• Maintain organized filing systems for sensitive records and correspondence

• Coordinate with vendors and service providers, tracking key deliverables and timelines

• Manage contracts, invoices, and expense workflows through approval and signature processes

4. Travel & Logistics

• Arrange comprehensive domestic and international travel — flights, hotels, visas, and itineraries

• Prepare detailed trip briefings aligned with meeting objectives and business priorities

5. Project & Operations Support

• Drive coordination across cross-functional projects and initiatives

• Track action items and deliverables from leadership meetings

• Prepare agendas, presentations, and board-level materials as required

• Support budget tracking, invoicing, and expense reporting for the leadership office

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

• Prior experience in a corporate, professional services, or fast-paced business environment strongly preferred

• Bachelor's degree in any discipline

• Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive, confidential information with discretion

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams)

KEY COMPETENCIES

• Discretion & Confidentiality

• Organizational Excellence

• Proactive Communication

• Stakeholder Management

• Attention to Detail

• Adaptability & Initiative

InMobi is one the largest Independent Adtech players globally with a record of accomplishment for innovation, customer-centricity and a privacy-first approach. We have been recognized on both 2018 and 2019 CNBC disruptor 50 list and as one of Fast Company’s 2018 Most Innovative Companies.

We have diversified revenue across several different B2B and B2C lines of business on a global scale. The North America market is our largest global market, and where our largest clients and publisher partners are based.

Our culture is our true north, enabling us to think big, solve complex challenges and grow with new opportunities. InMobians are passionate and driven, creative and fun-loving, take ownership and are results focused. Your work is visible, and you have an opportunity to make a real impact on a large organization.

We are looking for a Lead – Workspace Transportation to manage employee transportation for our Bangalore office. As the service expands, this role will own daily operations, vendor performance, route planning, employee communication, and cost control, with a strong focus on safety and reliable pickup and drop services.

The lead will be the primary contact for transportation matters and work closely with Workspace leadership, transport partners, Security, HR, Finance, and Procurement. The role requires hands-on operational ownership, sound judgment during disruptions, and a practical understanding of Bangalore traffic and employee commuting needs.

Key responsibilities

Daily operations and capacity planning

• Oversee daily pickup and drop operations, including trip scheduling, vehicle allocation, driver readiness, dispatch, and completion tracking.

• Plan service capacity using employee demand, office attendance, shift timings, new joiner requirements, and approved service coverage.

• Coordinate route planning and pickup points to balance employee convenience, travel time, vehicle occupancy, and cost. Review routes regularly as demand changes.

• Account for Bangalore traffic, rain, road closures, and peak-hour congestion when setting schedules. Arrange approved backup vehicles and vendors for disruptions.

• Monitor live trips through the transport platform and vendor control teams. Respond promptly to delays, missed pickups, vehicle breakdowns, and last-minute changes.

• Maintain clear operating procedures for bookings, cancellations, no-shows, route changes, exceptions, and escalation handovers.

Vendor and driver management

• Manage transport partners against agreed service levels, fleet commitments, pricing, and response times. Conduct regular reviews and document corrective actions.

• Coordinate with vendor supervisors and dispatch teams to ensure sufficient vehicles, qualified drivers, and operational support for each service window.

• Assess proposed vendors with Procurement and relevant teams, compare quotations, and support commercial discussions and onboarding.

• Monitor driver conduct, punctuality, route adherence, and complaints. Require vendors to address inappropriate behaviour and recurring performance issues.

• Track vendor contracts, renewal dates, rate cards, and service commitments. Maintain an updated contact directory and escalation matrix.

Safety service quality and financial ownership

Employee safety and transport compliance

• Coordinate verification of driver identity, licences, background checks, and required vehicle documents through approved company and vendor processes.

• Track validity of applicable vehicle permits, insurance, fitness, pollution certificates, and other required records with vendors and the relevant internal teams.

• Ensure vendors follow company-approved transport safety procedures, including applicable requirements for late-hour travel and women employee safety.

• Monitor the availability and functioning of required vehicle safety features, tracking systems, emergency contacts, and communication arrangements.

• Coordinate periodic vehicle and service checks with vendors. Escalate unsafe vehicles or drivers promptly and arrange replacements before service resumes.

• Handle employee location, contact, and trip data confidentially, with access and sharing limited to approved business needs.

Escalations and emergency response

• Act as the primary operational escalation contact for employee transport concerns and coordinate timely resolution with vendors and internal teams.

• Maintain response procedures for accidents, breakdowns, safety concerns, severe weather, and service disruptions. Coordinate with Security and emergency services when needed.

• Keep employees informed of delays and alternative arrangements through approved channels, with clear updates until the issue is resolved.

• Prepare contingency plans for vehicle shortages, vendor outages, and driver availability issues, including approved alternate providers.

• Document incidents, investigate causes with the responsible teams, and track preventive actions. Escalate material safety or service failures to Workspace leadership.

• Provide support during critical service windows and after-hours emergencies under an agreed coverage arrangement, with documented backup and handovers.

Budgets billing and cost control

• Prepare transportation budgets and demand forecasts. Monitor monthly spending and highlight variances or additional funding needs before commitments are made.

• Validate vendor invoices against completed trips, approved rate cards, kilometres or hours where applicable, and authorised additional charges.

• Maintain supporting trip records, approvals, purchase orders where applicable, invoices, and reconciliation reports for payment and audit.

• Work with Finance and Procurement to resolve billing discrepancies and ensure approved payments are processed within agreed timelines.

• Improve vehicle utilisation and route efficiency, reduce avoidable empty runs and no-shows, and assess savings without compromising safety or agreed service standards.

Employee experience reporting and candidate requirements

Employee communication and continuous improvement

• Explain transport eligibility, booking processes, pickup schedules, cancellations, and service changes clearly to employees.

• Coordinate with HR and Workspace teams to support new joiner transport onboarding and changes in employee commuting requirements.

• Collect employee feedback, track complaints to closure, and identify recurring issues requiring route changes or vendor action.

• Maintain an operational dashboard covering punctuality, completed and missed trips, occupancy, complaints, incidents, vendor performance, and costs.

• Share regular updates with Workspace leadership and recommend service improvements supported by operational data. Establish measurable service targets with leadership and vendors.

Education and experience

• Bachelor’s degree in any discipline. A qualification in operations, logistics, supply chain, hospitality, or business administration is preferred.

• Preferably five to eight years of relevant experience in corporate employee transportation, fleet operations, or transport vendor management, including experience independently leading operations.

• Experience managing multiple transport vendors, service escalations, route planning, billing validation, and operational reporting.

• Strong understanding of Bangalore commuting patterns and practical experience managing services during traffic congestion and operational disruptions.

• Experience using employee transport management platforms such as RouteMatic or similar systems is preferred.

Skills and working approach

• Strong English communication and stakeholder coordination. Working knowledge of Kannada or Hindi is helpful for local vendor coordination.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including expense trackers, data reconciliation, and service dashboards; working knowledge of Word and PowerPoint.

• Ability to prioritise live operational issues, make decisions within delegated authority, and escalate risks early.

• Strong negotiation, attention to detail, and follow-through, with a service mindset and a firm approach to safety and vendor accountability.

• Ability to guide vendor supervisors and transport coordinators, maintain clear handovers, and support onsite operations across required service windows.

Measures of success

• Pickup and drop punctuality and trip fulfilment against agreed service targets.

• Timely resolution of employee concerns and fewer recurring vendor failures.

• Complete and current driver and vehicle verification records, with safety actions tracked to closure.

• Accurate billing reconciliation, timely monthly reporting, and spending within approved budgets.

• Improved vehicle utilisation and route efficiency, supported by a tested contingency and escalation plan.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

• Apply statistical methods to explain performance: regression, time-series forecasting, variance decomposition, hypothesis testing, and anomaly detection.

• Explore large, messy datasets to find patterns, explain why numbers move, and turn those findings into recommendations leaders can act on.

• Validate models and metrics rigorously, including back-testing forecasts and quantifying uncertainty.

Automate reporting and decision support

• Replace manual reporting with automated, scheduled, and tested data solutions.

• Build interactive dashboards and metrics layers in Rill and Power BI that summarize performance and surface recommended actions, not just charts.

• Define metrics once in a governed semantic layer so every dashboard reports the same numbers.

Build AI agents and intelligent workflows

• Design and deploy automations, reporting and insight generation using agents and workflows for tasks such as commentary drafting, anomaly explanation, reconciliation checks, and ad hoc data Q&A.

• Identify where agents create real leverage and where simpler automation is the better answer.

Work independently and drive outcomes

• Scope requirements directly with stakeholders, make reasonable trade-offs, and deliver without step-by-step direction.

• Own the full lifecycle: technical design, build, testing, documentation, deployment, monitoring, and issue resolution.

• Write modular, reusable, version-controlled code that others can maintain.

Tool Stack

• Python: data processing, automation, statistical analysis, and LLM integration

• Spark / PySpark: large-scale transformation (on Databricks or equivalent)

• SQL: modeling and analysis

• Rill: metrics views and operational dashboards

• Power BI: executive reporting

• Claude / LLM APIs: agent and workflow development

• Git: version control

What We Are Looking For

Must-have

• 2 to 5 years of experience in analytics, data engineering, or finance systems.

• Python: 2+ years, including writing tested, modular code for data pipelines and automation.

• Spark / PySpark: 2+ years of hands-on experience building production jobs on Databricks or a comparable platform.

• SQL: Strong, with experience modeling data for analytics and finance use cases.

• Rill or a comparable BI-as-code tool (Looker LookML, Cube, or similar): 1+ year of hands-on use, or a demonstrated ability to become productive quickly.

• Power BI: Working knowledge of data modeling and DAX (or equivalent).

• Statistics: Applied experience with regression, time-series forecasting, hypothesis testing, and anomaly detection.

• ETL/ELT and lakehouse experience: Hands-on with tools such as Databricks, dbt, or Airflow, and familiarity with warehouse and lakehouse architecture.

• LLM APIs: Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Claude preferred), including prompt design, tool use, structured outputs, and evaluation.

• Finance fundamentals: Solid understanding of accounting, financial statements, and FP&A concepts. Able to build and check financial models.

• Databricks certification (Data Engineer Associate or Professional) or an equivalent cloud data certification.

• Exposure to ad tech, digital media, or high-volume transactional businesses.

• Ownership: You take a problem from vague request to working solution without waiting to be told how.

• Curiosity: You explore data, find patterns in messy datasets, and ask why numbers move.

• Pragmatism: You choose the simplest solution that is reliable, maintainable, and actually used.

• Collaboration: You align Finance, Product, and Tech stakeholders on priorities and trade-offs.

• Bias for results: Strategy only matters once it turns into outcomes.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.

If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.

opportunities.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Database Reliability Engineer to own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our end-to-end database infrastructure. You will manage both our low-latency transactional engines and our real-time analytical/lakehouse storage systems. You will bridge systems engineering, database internals, and automation to maintain rock-solid data integrity, low query latency, and high availability across the entire data lifecycle.

What you'll do

• Performance & Query Optimization: Diagnose and resolve latency regressions, lock/latch contention, index strategies, and memory/disk bottlenecks across both row-oriented and columnar engines.

• Disaster Recovery & Data Integrity: Ensure strict RTO/RPO adherence, automated backup validation, PITR (point-in-time recovery), and data consistency across transactional and analytical stores.

• Storage Optimization & Compaction: Manage compaction policies, partition strategies, file sizing, and storage tiering to minimize storage costs and read amplification.

• Transactional Reliability & Operations: Manage HA, automated failover, replication topology, and zero-downtime maintenance for production RDBMS clusters.

• Analytical Storage Infrastructure: Maintain, scale, and optimize real-time analytical engines (ClickHouse) and lakehouse formats/engines (Apache Iceberg, BigQuery).

• Infrastructure as Code & Observability: Build declarative automation for cluster provisioning, schema migrations, and metric alerting (Prometheus, PromQL, Grafana)

Experience you'll need

• Database Internals & RDBMS Fundamentals:

• Deep understanding of ACID guarantees, WAL, checkpointing, and recovery mechanics (e.g., ARIES-style recovery).

• Comprehensive grasp of concurrency control, transaction isolation levels, lock protocols (2PL, deadlocks), and MVCC architectures.

• Deep knowledge of storage structures: B+ Trees, LSM-Trees, and columnar storage layouts (e.g., Parquet, ORC, ClickHouse Wide/Compact formats).

• Operational Database Experience:

• 4+ years running production database infrastructure, with deep expertise in [PostgreSQL / MySQL].

• Experience optimizing and managing cost/quotas in Google Cloud BigQuery (partitioning, clustering, reservation slots).

• Experience with OLAP DB like: ClickHouse, BQ

• Systems & Kernel Engineering:

• Strong Linux fundamentals: I/O subsystems, page cache vs. engine buffer pools, disk alignment, asynchronous I/O, and memory management.

• Automation & Software Engineering:

• Using Python or Go for building database automation, operators, and CLI tooling.

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and container orchestration.

Preferred skills and qualifications

• Hands-on administration and performance tuning of ClickHouse (cluster topologies, ZooKeeper/Keeper coordination, MergeTree engine family, mutations, and compaction).

• Experience with change data capture (CDC) pipelines (e.g., Debezium, Kafka) feeding transactional updates into ClickHouse/Iceberg.

• Experience managing lakehouse storage patterns using Apache Iceberg (metadata management, snapshot expiration, file compaction/orphan cleanup).

• Experience with automated schema migration tools (e.g., gh-ost, Liquibase, Bytebase).

• Familiarity with distributed consensus engines ( ClickHouse Keeper,Raft, Paxos).

We are seeking an experienced HR Business Partner, R&D to partner with managers across the Engineering and Product functions to strengthen manager capability, build high-performing teams, and drive business and talent outcomes.

This hands-on role focuses on manager coaching, performance management, compensation planning, organizational health, and people program execution. As a trusted advisor, you will help managers navigate complex people decisions, improve team performance, and build the capabilities required to achieve business objectives. You will diagnose organizational challenges, identify opportunities and translate them into practical, high-impact people solutions. You will also help shape the future of HR business partnering by leveraging AI and agentic workflows to improve decision quality, expand HRBP leverage, enhance manager support, and deliver scalable people solutions.

This role is designed for a highly accountable HRBP who thrives in a high-velocity environment, takes ownership of outcomes, has strong bias for action, proactively solves problems, and continuously improves how work gets done. The ideal candidate combines the judgment of a trusted advisor, the execution rigor of an operator, and the mindset of a builder.

Scope of Impact

Business Partnership

• Build trusted partnerships with managers and leaders across supported R&D organizations, serving as a credible advisor on talent, organization, and people-related decisions.

• Translate business objectives into practical solutions that enable organizational effectiveness.

• Balance business priorities, employee experience, and long-term organizational implications when advising managers

• Proactively identify organizational risks, capability gaps, talent concerns, and workforce trends, and drive recommendations that improve business outcomes.

Manager & Leadership Capability

• Advise first-line and mid-level managers on people leadership, performance management, employee development, engagement, organizational health, and team effectiveness.

• Identify capability gaps and implement targeted interventions that strengthen manager effectiveness and team performance.

• Coach managers through challenging employee situations, difficult conversations, performance concerns, organizational change, and development planning.

• Provide guidance on HR policies, processes, and people practices while reinforcing broader organizational considerations.

• Deliver manager enablement and leadership development initiatives that improve effectiveness and consistency at scale.

Performance, Talent Management and Compensation

• Own execution of annual people programs, including performance reviews, calibration discussions, talent reviews, and compensation planning, ensuring high-quality outcomes and strong manager engagement

• Coach managers through complex performance management decisions and strengthen performance expectations, accountability, and employee development practices.

• Identify talent, retention, succession, and capability risks and develop mitigation plans with managers

• Partner on compensation decisions aligned with company philosophy and leverage workforce insights to improve decision quality.

HR Program Design, Execution & AI-Enabled Transformation

• Design, implement, scale, and improve people programs that enhance manager effectiveness and organizational outcomes.

• Simplify, automate, and redesign people processes with a focus on outcomes rather than digitizing legacy workflows.

• Champion AI, automation, and agentic workflows across HRBP work to improve decision quality, increase capacity, and deliver scalable people solutions and impact beyond traditional human capacity.

• Deliver integrated HR solutions in partnership with the broader People team and identify innovative approaches that improve productivity, adoption, and effectiveness.

Organizational Health, Engagement & Development

• Advise leaders on organizational health, culture, and team effectiveness while strengthening the development, retention, and engagement of key talent.

• Use workforce sentiment, organizational insights, and people analytics to identify risks, diagnose challenges, and implement sustainable solutions.

Employee Relations

• Resolve employee concerns in partnership with managers and collaborate with Legal on sensitive, high-risk, or specialized matters.

How You Create Impact

• Translate complex business priorities into focused, executable people solutions.

• Influence decisions through expertise, credibility, and practical problem-solving.

• Demonstrate urgency, ownership, and follow-through while balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

• Leverage data, organizational insight, and systems thinking to diagnose challenges and develop scalable solutions.

• Strengthen manager effectiveness through coaching, development, and enablement.

• Drive execution of talent, performance, compensation, and people programs that improve organizational outcomes.

• Navigate employee relations and performance matters with sound judgment and appropriate risk assessment.

• Leverage AI, automation, and agentic workflows to increase impact, productivity, and scale.

What Success Looks Like

• Be known for speed, ownership, sound judgment, and turning ambiguous people challenges into actionable solutions.

• Build trusted advisor relationships with managers who proactively seek your guidance on critical talent and organizational decisions.

• Elevate manager capability, accountability, and team effectiveness across supported organizations.

• Deliver strong execution of performance, talent, compensation, and people programs that improve business outcomes.

• Anticipate organizational risks and continuously improve how people work is delivered through AI, automation, and scalable solutions.

Qualifications & Experience

• Required Qualifications: Minimum 8 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3+ years as a People Partner or HR Business Partner, with a Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field; or 6+ years of experience with a Master's degree.

• Preferred Qualifications: Experience supporting R&D client group
