opportunities.title: IT System Administrator I
opportunities.description:
About The Team:

Come join our growing team to deliver amazing technology support experiences that fuel the vision of Dynamic Work for our employees. As a System Administrator, you will focus on delivering world-class technology support for both our employees and our workspaces, driven by the importance of the overall technology experience.

This role centers on swift resolution of employee IT issues and driving proactive improvements, all while maintaining a strong commitment to a customer-first approach. Operating with an automation-first mindset , we tackle complex problems, rely on data-driven decision-making, and prioritize the overall employee experience in everything we do.

As a member of our globally distributed remote and onsite IT support team, you will be the primary link for our internal customers. Your core responsibility is to provide essential Service Desk support to employees, which includes troubleshooting via Slack, Zoom, or Email, as well as managing and escalating high-priority incidents and concerns. Furthermore, you will contribute to employee productivity by sharing knowledge, mentoring peers, and guiding users in the effective use of technology.

You will have a security-first mindset and let policies guide how you work with our customers. You will be a strong advocate for our employees, learning and understanding their technology challenges and championing change with modern AI and automation solutions that make it easier to get our best work done.

The successful System Administrator is expected to possess a strong grasp and proven capability in resolving issues across various technologies. This includes proficiency with hardware (Apple/Windows), mobile devices, networks, and operating systems, as well as common internet and SaaS applications (browsers, Slack, Google Workspace, Office, Okta) and AI agent workflows. The ideal candidate will also have great attention to detail and will be comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment.

Our goal is to make sure that our customers have an amazing technology experience and that they have everything they need to be successful.

What you’ll do:

• Deliver an exceptional customer support experience to all Rubrik employees and contractors. This position necessitates a 24/7 commitment, requiring flexibility to work across various shifts, including nights, weekends, and public holidays.

• Strive to achieve first-contact resolution for all employee support interactions whenever feasible. Diligently and proactively manage competing priorities within a high-velocity environment.

• Connect with employees via Slack and Zoom to provide real-time troubleshooting support, along with providing a superior transfer of support experience as needed.

• Manage end-to-end ticket lifecycles across Incident, Change, and Problem Management using JIRA.

• Drive ticket hygiene across the queue, build operational dashboards, and actively track and chase team KPIs and SLAs.

• Mentor junior team members on complex ticket resolutions, troubleshooting methodologies, and IT best practices.

• Apply an automation-first approach to identify process gaps, using critical thinking to streamline workflows and build custom AI agents (using tools like Claude Cowork/Code) for continuous process improvement.

• Support key Employee Lifecycle processes (onboarding and offboarding) and manage provisioning and deprovisioning of applications via Okta and Okta Workflows.

• Strong demonstrated written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate policies and technical processes with customers of all levels.

• Actively contribute to team knowledge by documenting newly found solutions for common issues and proactively sharing information with the team.

• Handle escalations from Level 1 Service Desk agents.

• Support complex problem-solving related to Slack, Google Workspace, MS O365, MDM tools (Jamf & Intune), and JIRA reporting.

• Perform regular audits on assets, onboarding, and offboarding data for accuracy and hygiene.

• Track and manage shift handovers.

Preferred qualifications:

• 5+ years supporting internal or external customers in a Global IT Service Desk environment.

• 5+ years experience supporting Mac and Windows devices.

• 5+ years managing user and role-based access in a predominantly SaaS-based environment.

• Hands-on experience administering Okta, building Okta Workflows, and managing macOS environments via Jamf.

• Hands-on experience with Claude (Cowork/Code) with proven ability to build AI agents for IT process automation and improvement.

• Strong ITIL foundation with proven experience handling Incident, Change, and Problem Management, alongside SLA/KPI tracking and dashboard creation.

• An automation-first outlook paired with strong critical thinking skills to identify operational gaps and eliminate manual tasks.

• Familiarity with or demonstrated experience in supporting video conferencing systems is desired.

• Proficiency in troubleshooting Windows and Mac platforms, leveraging expertise in Jamf and/or Intune.

• Proficiency in scripting languages such as Bash or Python for automation tasks related to Jamf is highly desirable (not mandatory, but good to have).

• Good working knowledge of Google Workspace, Slack, JIRA, MS O365, and MDM tools.

• Demonstrated strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

• Experience supporting high-priority escalations and high-pressure situations.

• Strong ability to prioritize multiple tasks to ensure support for customers and the team.

Additional skills or certifications a plus:

• Okta & Okta Workflows

• Claude (Code/Cowork) & AI Agent Development

• Google Workspace

• Jamf

• Intune

• Atlassian Suite (JIRA/Confluence)

• Slack

• O365

• Zoom

opportunities.title: Legal Counsel
opportunities.description:
Legal Counsel, Channels

Bangalore, India preferred (Hybrid in office 2 days a week) | Open to fully remote within India for the right candidate

About Our Team

The Rubrik Commercial Legal Team manages Rubrik's global commercial contracts and revenue-related legal matters. Within Commercial Legal, the Channels & Alliances legal team supports Rubrik's partner ecosystem: the distributors, resellers, managed service providers, global and regional system integrators, and alliance partners through which Rubrik sells its data security and cyber resilience products worldwide.

Rubrik goes to market primarily through a two-tier channel: Rubrik sells to a Distributor, the Distributor sells to a Reseller, and the Reseller sells to the end Customer. This role is the day-to-day legal partner for that business unit. You will be the first point of contact for the Channels organization on reseller and distributor agreements, amendments and partner program requests, keeping deals moving and partners compliant. You will join a small, collaborative team and work alongside a Channels Legal Counsel peer, reporting to the Director of Legal who leads Channels & Alliances, Marketplaces and Inbound Licensing.

This is a hands-on role for an attorney who already works in the channel world, enjoys negotiating with partners and wants to be a trusted advisor to a fast-moving sales organization.

Where You Can Make an Impact

• Own day-to-day channel contracting: Draft, review and negotiate reseller agreements, distributor agreements, amendments, adoption agreements for partner affiliates, resale enablement amendments and other documents partners need to resell Rubrik's SaaS and subscription products.

• Live in the two-tier channel model: Apply a deep working knowledge of Rubrik's go-to-market: Rubrik sells to a Distributor, who sells to a Reseller, who sells to the end Customer. Understand how order flow, pricing and discounts, deal registration, flow-down terms and end-user agreements work across each tier, and spot when a request breaks the model.

• Be the front door for the Channels organization: Manage the channel contract-request intake queue. Triage, prioritize and route incoming requests, resolve routine matters yourself and escalate exceptions with a clear recommendation.

• Support the Partner Program: Advise Partner Programs and Partner Operations on partner program requests, program terms and conditions, tier and status changes, program exceptions, incentive and referral arrangements, and partner onboarding and offboarding.

• Advise channel leaders and account managers: Act as a trusted advisor to Channel Account Managers, Distribution leaders, Alliances and the Channels Global Partner Organization. Answer their questions with practical, business-ready guidance and help them close deals on standard terms.

• Negotiate directly with partners: Lead negotiations and calls with partner legal, procurement and business teams. Hold Rubrik's standard positions, use approved fallbacks and know when to escalate.

• Build and maintain templates and playbooks: Create and update channel agreement templates, amendment forms, negotiation playbooks, fallback positions, FAQs and training so the ecosystem stays on standard terms and the business can self-serve.

• Drive deals to signature: Coordinate internal approvals, signature requests and e-signature execution, and work with Partner Operations and Deal Desk so executed agreements are recorded correctly in Salesforce and partners can transact.

• Apply a compliance and competition lens: Identify and escalate antitrust and competition law issues common to distribution (resale price maintenance, dual distribution, territorial and customer restrictions, exclusivity), as well as anti-corruption, sanctions and export, and public-sector procurement issues.

• Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with Commercial Legal, Privacy, Security, Revenue, Tax, Deal Desk and Partner Operations to deliver consistent answers and keep channel terms aligned with Rubrik's customer-facing terms.

• Support a global channel: Work IST business hours while supporting partners and stakeholders worldwide, with a primary focus on APAC and EMEA and meaningful AMER coverage. Flex your hours during quarter-end and other peak periods to support AMER deals.

• Improve how we work: Spot repeat questions and bottlenecks, propose process and template fixes, and use technology (including AI tools) to speed up routine work.

Ideal Background

• Licensed attorney in India (LL.B. and enrolled with a State Bar Council) with 3 to 6 years of post-qualification experience, including meaningful in-house experience at a technology or SaaS company.

• Currently working in a channel, partner or distribution contracting role. You negotiate reseller and distributor agreements today and understand two-tier distribution and how SaaS is resold through partners.

• Comfortable negotiating directly with partner legal and procurement teams and advising business stakeholders without a safety net.

• Working knowledge of partner programs, deal registration, subscription and SaaS commercial models, and how channel terms interact with end-customer terms.

• Awareness of competition and compliance issues in distribution relationships and of anti-bribery and anti-corruption rules that apply to selling through partners.

• Excellent English drafting and communication skills. You write clearly, explain risk in business terms and give a recommendation, not a menu.

• Organized and reliable in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment. You prioritize well, track your queue and close the loop.

• Independent, proactive and business-oriented, with sound judgment about what to decide and what to escalate.

• Experience with Salesforce, DocuSign or similar e-signature tools, and contract lifecycle management systems is a plus.

• Willingness to flex working hours periodically to support AMER-based deals and quarter-end activity.

Working Model

Our preferred candidate is based in Bangalore and works from the Rubrik office two days a week. We will consider remote candidates elsewhere in India for the right fit. You will work standard IST business hours and support a global partner base, with a primary emphasis on APAC and EMEA and regular AMER coverage. Periodic late-evening availability for AMER deals and quarter-end is expected, but not an everyday requirement.

opportunities.title: Principal Engineer
opportunities.description:
About the role

Rubrik is the Security and AI Operations Company. As we move from protecting data to securing and accelerating our customers' AI transformation, we are rethinking how the whole company works and fully embracing AI in everything we do.

The Principal Engineer is a strategic, hands-on role at the same level as an Engineering Director. You will define and execute the technical strategy for Rubrik's AI software factory, the platform on which agents and people take an idea all the way to customer value.

To get there, we are moving from an AI-assisted Software Development Lifecycle to an AI Product Development Lifecycle (AI-PDLC), which covers every stage, not just code. Agents do the synthesis, drafting and execution, while people provide judgment and give accountable approval at every key decision. The platform is at an early stage, and you will lead the build of the shared foundation that every function at Rubrik, from Product, Design and Engineering to Sales and Marketing, will use it for its AI workflows.

Your primary focus is problem seeking: finding where AI can make the biggest difference, from building products to serving customers, and making the case to fund it.

What you'll do

Platform strategy

• Define the technical vision for the AI-PDLC platform: orchestration, approval gates, model and tool gateways, agent runtimes, context, evals and cost visibility.

• Make the platform usable by every function through clear contracts, paved paths and self-serve tooling.

• Decide what Rubrik should own, build on and borrow.

• Turn business opportunities and productivity gaps across Product, Design, Engineering, Support and go-to-market teams into multi-quarter roadmaps.

Technical leadership and standards

• Set the standards for trustworthy agentic workflows: a person approves every agent output, and no workflow skips its quality or security checkpoints.

• Champion eval-driven development, managed agent identities with native access control, and outcome metrics such as landed rate, revert rate and cost per landed change.

• Own cross-cutting initiatives (up to about 18 engineers' effort) end to end. Stay hands-on: prototype, write code and review critical changes.

Influence and growth

• Build consensus across Engineering, Product, Design, Support, Security and business functions.

• Lead the organizational change that AI-native work requires, where ownership means accountability rather than gatekeeping.

• Coach Engineers toward Principal-level impact, raise the hiring bar, and represent Rubrik externally.

About you

• Typically 15+ years in software engineering, with a significant focus on developer or internal platforms.

• Proven at Director-level scope, driving technical strategy across multiple complex systems and organizations.

• Hands-on experience running LLMs and agents in production, including orchestration, tool integration (for example, MCP), context engineering, evals and guardrails.

• Deep expertise in a general-purpose language (for example, Go, Java, C/C++, Scala or Python) and strong first-principles thinking.

• Experience scaling secure, highly available platforms, including identity, access control and cost governance.

• Data-driven: defines outcome metrics and uses them to steer investment and prove impact.

• A consensus builder and coach who communicates clearly with executives, non-technical stakeholders and global teams.

opportunities.description:
Product Management Intern – Identity Resilience

About the Team & Role

The Product Management team at Rubrik drives forward our vision of delivering a market-leading platform that addresses the world’s most critical cyber resilience and data security challenges.

The Identity Resilience team is Rubrik’s fastest-growing business unit, operating with a high-velocity "0-to-1" charter. Today, modern cyberattacks almost exclusively weaponize identity systems. When identity fails, the entire enterprise halts. Our mission is to ensure enterprise identity environments are secure, observable, compliant, and instantly recoverable.

We are looking for a strategically sharp, technical, and execution-minded Product Management Intern for a high-impact 2-month internship based in Bengaluru. As an intern, you will own a core strategic initiative – bridging enterprise customer pain points, competitive differentiation, and technical architecture to deliver a concrete product roadmap for next-generation identity protection.

What You’ll Do (2-Month Charter)

• Market Landscape & Threat Vector Analysis: Benchmark the enterprise identity attack surface across hybrid environments. Map emerging threat vectors to potential resilience and recovery capabilities.

• Customer Discovery & Pain Point Synthesis: Work alongside PM and GTM mentors to analyze customer requirements, telemetry data, and enterprise security frameworks to pinpoint the highest-friction operational gaps for Security and IAM teams.

• Feature Strategy & PRD Ownership: Define the scope, user workflows, and success metrics for a targeted identity protection/recovery feature. Author a high-quality Product Requirement Document (PRD) balancing enterprise-grade depth with Rubrik’s trademark simplicity.

• Cross-Functional Architecture Alignment: Collaborate closely with Engineering, UX Design, and Architecture leads to evaluate technical trade-offs, define API/data pipeline requirements, and ensure feasibility.

• Executive Strategy Pitch: Conclude your internship with an Executive Product Readout to Senior Leadership, defending your business case, technical trade-offs, and proposed roadmap.

What You’ll Need

• Education: Currently enrolled in a premier MBA/management program (IIM, ISB, or equivalent global top-tier business school) graduating in 2027/28

• Technical Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or an equivalent engineering discipline. Prior product management or technical experience in enterprise systems, cloud platforms, or cybersecurity is a strong plus.

• Systems & Security Thinking: An understanding of enterprise software fundamentals; familiarity with core identity concepts is an advantage.

• Problem Solving: Comfort with ambiguity, structured thinking, and the ability to break complex, undefined problems into crisp, actionable requirements.

• Communication & Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate technical trade-offs to senior product and engineering leaders.

• Location: Based in or willing to relocate to Bengaluru for the 2-month internship duration (Hybrid model).

What You’ll Gain

• True 0-to-1 Problem Ownership: Direct ownership of a real-world, high-priority product problem in enterprise cybersecurity – not a back-burner sandbox project.

• High-Stakes Leadership Visibility: Regular 1:1 mentorship from seasoned Product Managers and a final presentation to Product & Engineering leadership.

• Cybersecurity PM Expertise: Hands-on exposure to cutting-edge identity governance, threat modeling, and resilience frameworks inside an enterprise security market leader.

About Team & About Role
Identity is now the front door for attackers, and organisations across government, financial services, healthcare and critical infrastructure rely on Rubrik to recover quickly when identity systems like Active Directory and Entra ID are compromised. As an Account Executive, Identity Resilience, you'll take a category-defining product to customers in some of the most regulated markets in the world, building a new revenue stream alongside the Identity Sales Specialist team and shaping how Rubrik wins in identity from the earliest stage of the motion.

What You'll Do

• Own and exceed your identity resilience quota across your territory, turning identity into a core part of every strategic security conversation with your customers

• Build and execute territory plans for Identity Resilience, prioritising the accounts and verticals that feel identity risk most acutely, so Rubrik is in front of the right buyers at the right moment • Lead executive conversations with CISOs, CIOs and identity and infrastructure leaders, creating urgency around Active Directory and Entra ID recovery and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals

• Generate and develop pipeline through outbound prospecting, existing Rubrik relationships and joint account planning with Account Executives and Sales Engineers, so identity becomes part of the conversation from the first meeting

• Work with channel partners, GSIs and specialist resellers to build joint plays that extend Rubrik's reach beyond what the direct motion can achieve alone

• Partner with Sales Engineers to run discovery, demonstrations and proofs of value that translate technical identity attack paths into clear business risk and measurable resilience

• Maintain accurate forecasting and disciplined pipeline hygiene, and share what you learn from the field with Product and Marketing so competitive insight and regional requirements shape the roadmap and messaging

• Share your identity expertise with colleagues across the field and help enable the wider sales team to lead with identity, growing your own influence as the motion scales

Experience You'll Need

• Substantial experience selling identity security, IAM, privileged access or adjacent cybersecurity solutions into enterprise and public sector customers, with a track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota

• Demonstrated success leading complex, executive-level sales cycles with CISOs and senior security and infrastructure stakeholders

• Strong understanding of the identity threat landscape, including Active Directory and Entra ID attack paths, and the ability to translate technical risk into business impact

• Experience building pipeline in a new or emerging product category, with the self-direction to create momentum where no playbook yet exists

• Experience working with partners, resellers or GSIs to influence and co-sell into target accounts

• Comfort operating across the regulatory environments and buying cultures of the markets in your territory

• Willingness to travel regularly for customer, partner and field engagements

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience selling in the cyber resilience, data security or identity recovery space, including familiarity with identity security and AD recovery vendors

• Own the SaaS product line number: partner with core Account Executives to identify, qualify, and close SaaS data protection and security opportunities across net-new and existing accounts.

• Lead with technical credibility: articulate Rubrik’s SaaS architecture, security posture, and the gaps in Microsoft’s and Google’s native shared responsibility model in a way that resonates with both technical and business buyers.

• Drive technical discovery and validation: run or co-lead discovery calls, demos, and proof-of-concept engagements for M365, Google Workspace, and Salesforce workloads alongside Sales Engineers. • Win competitive deals: build and defend positioning against SaaS-native vendors, translating technical differentiation into business value.

• Build territory and account plans: develop a coverage strategy in partnership with core sales, SE, and channel teams to maximize SaaS attach and expansion within the install base.

• Engage multiple stakeholders: present to IT administrators, security and compliance teams, and executive economic buyers, tailoring the message to each audience.

What You’ll Bring

• SaaS sales experience: 3+ years of quota-carrying sales experience selling SaaS data protection, security, or governance solutions for Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or Salesforce environments.

• Directly relevant background: experience at a SaaS data protection or management vendor is strongly preferred.

• Genuine technical depth: comfortable discussing tenant architecture, APIs, identity and access management (Entra ID/Azure AD), backup and recovery mechanics, and security and compliance frameworks without relying solely on a Sales Engineer.

• Consultative approach: comfortable navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles across IT, security, and executive buyers in mid-market and enterprise accounts.

• Overlay/specialist experience: prior success working in a platform-selling model alongside core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success.

• Track record: consistent history of quota attainment and strong pipeline generation.

• Education: bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

• Hands-on familiarity with Microsoft 365 administration, Entra ID/Azure AD, or Salesforce administration.

opportunities.title: Senior AI Engineer - Enterprise Agentic Systems
opportunities.description:
About the role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join Rubrik's Applied AI Apps org, building production-grade, full-stack applications and APIs for our internal Business teams while embedding AI-agentified capabilities into these internal platforms. This is a hands-on build role: you will own features end to end from database schema through backend services and distributed systems to the user interface and bring practical, hands-on experience building or integrating AI agents, tool-calling workflows along with the right AI evals or LLM-powered features into production systems that our business stakeholders rely on.

The ideal candidate combines strong full-stack engineering fundamentals with a systems mindset for reliability and scale, and has spent meaningful hands-on time (1–2 years) building AI-agentified applications not just experimenting with AI tools, but shipping agentic features in production. We are targeting 8+ years of overall software engineering experience; this is flexible for candidates who demonstrate strong depth across full-stack, distributed systems, and applied AI engineering skills during technical evaluation.

What you'll do

Key Responsibilities:

• Build and productionize agentic workflows, LLM-powered automation, and AI-assisted tooling having hands-on experience with these systems.

• Design and build end-to-end agent evaluation frameworks that measure correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate, including synthetic test environments that stress-test agents built on Google ADK and Google AI/ML services (Vertex AI, Gemini) under diverse real-world conditions.

• Curate golden datasets and test harnesses for our Rubrik enterprise use cases and contribute to an eval-as-a-service platform that IT teams can self-serve against standard and custom benchmarks.

• Automate regression and drift detection with CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployments

• Architect for distributed systems concerns: scalability, fault tolerance, data consistency, and service boundaries across backend and data layers.

• Build full-stack web applications and own features end to end be it database schema, backend services, APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and webhooks), and frontend (React/Next.js) user interface

• Design and build APIs and services that are consumed by applications, internal tools, and AI agents/LLMs, including tool-calling interfaces

• Apply reliability engineering practices — observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, incident response, and post-incident reviews — to keep production systems healthy.

• Clarify requirements upfront, surface blockers early, and communicate progress proactively without being asked.

• Collaborate openly with internal Business stakeholders, Product, QA, DevOps, and UX or designer teams; avoid working in silos.

Experience you'll need

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

• 5-7 years of Salesforce experience.

• Strong knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud (or Pardot), Channel/Partner Portals, and Salesforce Admin functionalities.

• Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud and Case Management is a plus.

• Proficiency in troubleshooting complex issues involving Apex, Flows, Workflows, Process Builder, Validation Rules, Reports & Dashboards.

• Familiarity with Salesforce integration tools (e.g., MuleSoft, Zapier, Marketing Automation Platforms).

• Salesforce Administrator certification is required; additional certifications (e.g., Platform App Builder, Marketing Cloud Administrator, Marketing Cloud Email Specialist) are a plus.

Required Qualification

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience across full-stack engineering (flexible based on demonstrated strength in technical evaluation).

• 1–2 years of hands-on experience building, integrating and operating AI Agent powered applications (agentic workflows, tool-calling, RAG, LLM-powered features) in production..

• Demonstrated experience owning systems designed for scale and reliability, not just feature delivery.

Technical Skills — Applied AI Engineering

• 1–2 years of hands-on experience building AI applications, using agent frameworks (e.g., Claude Agent SDK, Google ADK, LangGraph, or equivalent).

• Practical understanding of latency, cost, rate limiting, and safety/guardrails when exposing systems for AI consumption.

• Experience with coding agents, Spec Driven and Eval Driven Development

• Deep hands-on experience with LLM evaluation — familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as LangSmith, DeepEval, LLM as a Judge, Promptfoo, RAGAS, Hugging Face evaluation tooling, custom eval harnesses

• Strong understanding of agentic AI patterns — Supervisor Multi-Agent, ReAct/Plan-Execute reasoning chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)

Technical Skills — Full Stack Software Engineering

• Frontend: Strong JavaScript fundamentals; hands-on experience with React and Next.js for building modern, production-grade web applications (hooks, state management, component architecture, routing, server-side rendering).

• Backend: Proficient in Python, writing production-grade code; hands-on experience with FastAPI or Flask (or equivalent frameworks) for building REST APIs.

• Database: Experience with relational and non-relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, or equivalent); solid understanding of schema design, joins, indexing, and query optimization.

• APIs: Secure API design, API Gateway expertise with platforms such as Kong / Apigee / AWS API Gateway / Azure APIM / MuleSoft API Gateway for routing, rate limiting, and policy enforcement.

Technical Skills — Distributed Systems & Reliability Engineering

• Working knowledge of distributed systems concepts: service decomposition, consistency models, caching, queuing/messaging, and failure handling.

• Reliability engineering fundamentals: observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, error budgets, and operational runbooks.

• Ability to reason about system design trade-offs and build scalable, resilient solutions under ambiguity.

Soft Skills

• Proactive communication — shares updates without being asked and flags blockers early.

• Asks the right questions — clarifies requirements upfront before jumping into implementation.

• Ownership mindset — treats the project as their own rather than just completing tickets.

• Transparency — speaks up when something is unclear instead of making assumptions.

• Strong analytical mindset to break down complex or ambiguous problems.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with agentic frameworks (ADK, LangGraph, or similar) beyond individual projects — production deployment experience preferred.

• Familiarity with API documentation standards (Swagger/OpenAPI).

• Basic DevOps awareness (Docker, CI/CD) and Git/version-control best practices.

• Testing experience across unit and integration levels.

• Experience with modern web app tooling — component libraries (e.g., Tailwind, MUI) and state management (e.g., Redux, Zustand).

• Exposure to cloud-native development (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containers and infrastructure as code.

• Deep Learning/NLP Knowledge: Fundamental understanding of how LLMs work, including concepts like RAG, prompting, and the technical challenges related to alignment

• Data Analysis: Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Pandas, SQL) for analyzing evaluation and safety results

opportunities.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Applied AI Engineer at GitLab, you'll build and deploy AI-powered solutions for GitLab's own teams. You'll join Enterprise AI in the CIO organization, reporting to the Senior Director, Enterprise AI. This is a hands-on engineering role: you'll write production code and partner with senior engineers and internal business stakeholders to solve problems and deliver measurable outcomes. Your focus is GitLab's internal operations, rather than customer implementations or development of the GitLab product.

Building fast matters, and we want engineers who ship. But speed without understanding the problem leads to the wrong solution shipped quickly. You'll partner with senior engineers and stakeholders to understand the real problem first: how work moves across teams, where the real constraint lives, and whether AI is the right intervention. From there, you'll take ownership of the build and deployment, combining strong engineering skills with curiosity about the business systems you're improving.

Your initial focus will span GitLab's own Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support teams, where you'll embed AI solutions into the systems and workflows they use every day. This role offers the opportunity to grow as an engineer while shaping how GitLab team members work, in a remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment.

What you'll do

• Contribute to problem diagnosis alongside the team. Engage with stakeholders to understand the real constraint before reaching for a solution, and be willing to flag when AI isn't the right answer.

• Own the build and deployment of AI solutions, from technical design through implementation, deployment, and iteration. Partner with senior engineers on discovery and scoping.

• Design, develop, and ship AI-powered solutions quickly, delivering working prototypes in days, not months, with a focus on practical outcomes and measurable business value.

• Build solutions that reduce bottlenecks, shorten lead times, and increase throughput. Track flow, adoption, and ROI metrics defined for the work.

• Integrate AI capabilities into GitLab's internal business systems and workflows using APIs, orchestration tools, and modern AI platforms, including GitLab Duo Agent Platform, where appropriate. The right tool wins, whether that's custom code, a platform, or a well-crafted prompt.

• Be Customer Zero: use GitLab's AI products in our own internal workflows, assess how they perform in practice, and share feedback with R&D to help improve them.

• Partner with stakeholders to translate requirements into working solutions. Ask good questions, surface assumptions, and align with the team on outcomes before jumping to implementation.

• Track success against defined business metrics, flow metrics, and feedback loops that make performance visible and actionable.

• Contribute to documentation and reusable patterns that help the team scale its impact.

What you'll bring

• A Technologist at Heart - Genuinely invested in technology, the foundational and the cutting-edge in equal measure. You're as energized by a well-designed API integration as you are by the latest foundation model release. You reach for the simplest solution that solves the problem well, rather than forcing new technology when proven approaches would do. AI is a powerful part of your toolkit, but it sits on top of solid engineering fundamentals, not in place of them.

Competent, Confident Coding Skills - You can build working solutions end-to-end, write clean and maintainable code, and debug effectively. Whether your skills were honed in a traditional engineering role, through building automations, or shipping side projects, what matters is that you can deliver production-quality work independently. AI & LLM Technical Depth - Strong proficiency in at least one modern scripting language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar) and a solid understanding of REST APIs, GraphQL, and integration patterns. Practical, hands-on experience with modern AI technologies, specifically:

• Prompt engineering as a core discipline: designing effective system prompts, managing context windows, structuring multi-turn interactions, evaluating output quality, and iterating systematically on prompt design.

• Model selection and cost-performance trade-offs: developing judgment on when a smaller fine-tuned model outperforms a general-purpose large one, when RAG is the right architecture versus expanding the context window, and how to think about capability versus cost.

• Agentic architecture patterns: tool use, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop designs, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and production-grade reliability patterns.

• Practical fluency across the LLM ecosystem: hands-on experience with models from Anthropic, OpenAI, open-source alternatives, and growing judgment about which to reach for and when.

• AI Safety & Risk Awareness - You think critically about how the solutions you build could be exploited, misused, or produce unintended consequences. You know how to design appropriate guardrails (input validation, output filtering, access controls, prompt injection defenses, and data leakage prevention) and you treat these as first-class engineering concerns.

• Curiosity About Flow & Constraints - Comfortable engaging with workflow maps, end-to-end process diagrams, and constraint analysis. You instinctively ask "what's actually blocking flow here?" before asking "what model should I use?" You don't need to be the one leading the diagnosis yet, but you should be eager to learn and contribute.

• Business System Awareness - Familiarity with the landscape of enterprise business systems: CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation (Marketo), support platforms (Zendesk), integration and orchestration tools (Workato), AI platforms (Relevance AI), and enterprise search and knowledge tools (Glean). You don't need deep experience with all of these, but you should understand what they do, be willing to learn how they fit together, and be ready to build with and across them.

• Cross-Functional Communication - Comfortable having conversations with stakeholders across diverse domains, willing to invest in understanding their unique needs, and able to translate between technical and business language.

• Ownership Mindset - Track record of taking scoped initiatives from design through delivery. Comfortable operating with some ambiguity, and knows when to push forward independently versus when to ask for guidance.

• Product Mindset - Ability to scope MVPs, prioritize ruthlessly, and deliver iteratively. In addition, consider adoption, user experience, and business outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with GitLab platform and CI/CD workflows

• Background in solutions engineering, solutions architecture, consulting, or other stakeholder-facing technical roles, combining strong engineering skills with stakeholder engagement, solution design, and root cause analysis. Experience personally building and shipping production-quality solutions is especially relevant.

• Familiarity with value stream mapping, flow metrics, or Theory of Constraints thinking

• Experience with low-code/no-code orchestration tools (n8n, Make, Workato) alongside custom development

• Previous startup or high-growth company experience

About the team

You will join the Enterprise Technology & AI team in the CIO organization. We build and improve the internal systems and workflows that help GitLab team members make decisions, operate at scale, and do their best work.

We believe the best AI solutions start with understanding the system, not the technology. We value people who think in constraints and flow, who build with conviction, and who never stop learning. We work in an all-remote, asynchronous setting, guided by GitLab's operating principles of Speed with Quality, Ownership Mindset, and Customer Outcomes, built on a Culture of Excellence.

• Growth and Development Fund

• Parental Leave

You will work within a product area, partnering with Product Management, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Security to deliver predictably and contribute to the quality, security, performance, and maintainability of shared backend code and services. You will be trusted to work with minimal guidance, to know when to seek help, and to communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous environment — with other tenured engineers alongside you to review your work, think through hard problems with you, and help you grow.

• Ownership: You'll take features from requirements through delivery and follow-up; your code will run on a platform used by millions of users.

• Learning and Growth : You’ll work alongside your engineering team, who treat code review and design review as a learning loop rather than a gate — one of the fastest ways to grow your engineering judgment.

• Innovative Culture: You’ll use AI as a genuine part of daily engineering work, developing the judgment to know when to trust it and when not to.

• Autonomy: You’ll thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.

• User-Centric Collaboration: You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, so you understand why you’re building something, not just what.

• Test and Review: Add and improve automated coverage — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end where appropriate — and review others’ code for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and operational risk.

• Operate What You Build: Investigate build, test, deployment, and runtime failures at the feature boundary, identify technical debt and propose practical improvements, and take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

• Leverage AI: Use AI productively in daily work, validate what it produces, and understand where its limitations matter.

• On Call Support: Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

What you’ll bring

• Backend Fundamentals: Professional experience building and shipping production backend applications, with strong programming, API, database, testing, debugging, and performance fundamentals.

• Adaptability: Experience with Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern backend language. We value the ability to learn and adapt over mastery of a single language.

• Feature Ownership: The ability to take a feature from clarification through delivery and follow-up, working independently while seeking input at the right time.

• Practical Judgment: Sound instincts about security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational risk, plus an understanding of modular backend boundaries and the consequences of coupling.

• Clear Communication: Strong written communication and effective collaboration in a remote, asynchronous environment.

• AI Fluency: Practical experience with AI coding tools, including the ability to review and correct what they generate.

An overview of this role

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on GitLab's Security Factory: Code Scanning team, you'll help developers find and fix security issues in their code by contributing to the static analysis engine that finds them.

Your work spans both the engine and the tools we use to evaluate it. You'll extend how the engine models programs, from parsing source code and resolving symbols to building call graphs and tracking tainted data across files and languages. You'll also build and apply tooling to test its findings against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities, measuring both false positives and missed vulnerabilities.

We build the engine with artificial intelligence (AI) agents that write and review code from written specifications, under human direction. You'll implement component specifications within the team's architecture, working with engineers and AI agents. Good judgment about when to trust agent output, and when to bring it to human review, is central to the role.

What you'll do

• Extend the program model, including parsing, symbol resolution, intermediate representations, call graphs, and taint and data-flow analysis, to support new languages and frameworks.

• Build and apply AI-assisted tooling to implement, review, and validate engine changes and findings, in collaboration with the team's technical leadership. Measure detection quality against known vulnerabilities, judging changes primarily on false positive and false negative rates.

• Develop static application security testing (SAST) rules mapped to Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and the Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP), along with test fixtures that demonstrate they work.

• Implement component specifications with engineers and AI agents through phased plans and small, reviewable changes. Keep specifications and code in sync.

• Improve the harness, agent instructions, and skills that keep agent-written code trustworthy. Use separate coding and reviewing agents, performance checks, application programming interface (API) checks, and dependency checks, and escalate risky changes to human review.

• Solve technical problems of moderate scope and complexity, and identify and address technical debt that slows the team down.

• Write maintainable code that meets our internal standards, and help maintain those standards through code review.

• Participate in on-call rotations to help troubleshoot product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues.

• Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

What you'll bring

• Experience using AI or large language model (LLM) tools to generate or evaluate technical content, with the judgment to assess when their output is trustworthy.

• Solid professional experience writing and testing production code in a systems language, particularly Rust or Go. Our engine is written in Rust, the analyzer wrapper in Go, and the monolith integration in Ruby. You'll be willing to work across them.

• An interest in static analysis and application security, including parsing, intermediate representations, taint and data-flow analysis, and how vulnerabilities arise in code. Deep expertise isn't required; we'll help you grow it.

• Organize and progress your work independently in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.

• The ability to communicate technical problems clearly and concisely and propose iterative solutions.

• Helpful but not required: experience with performance optimization, Docker and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), web or mobile frameworks, guardrails for agent-written code such as mutation testing and fuzzing, or program analysis and security research through publications or open source contributions. Willingness to learn performance optimization and containerized workflows is also welcome.

The Security Factory: Code Scanning team develops GitLab's SAST capabilities for customer software repositories. We work closely with the Code Security team on scanning rules and flows, with Composition Analysis on the broader software supply chain, and with other groups across the Sec section. We rely heavily on asynchronous work across time zones.

An overview of this role

Help us build the next generation of authentication services at GitLab. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Authentication team, you'll build authentication features across the Rails monolith and GATE. GATE is our new service for issuing and validating tokens and managing identities, designed to support every GitLab deployment model.

You'll expand authentication mechanisms, including support for identities used by artificial intelligence (AI) agents. You'll also help keep GitLab and its customers secure by building access management tooling and addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.

GATE will become the foundation for token issuance, validation, and identity services across GitLab.com multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS), Self-Managed, Dedicated, and air-gapped environments. Your work will affect core components that customers, users, and GitLab teams rely on.

Some of our projects include:

• Building GATE as the centralized service for token issuance and validation

• Consolidating tokens and migrating authentication paths out of the Rails monolith

• Building passkeys and passwordless authentication

• Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI

• Improving service accounts and secure automation

• Enhancing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) capabilities for automated user provisioning and single sign-on (SSO)

What you'll do

• Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab's authentication services with the team.

• Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation.

• Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models.

• Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation.

• Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.

• Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review.

• Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab's values in these communications.

• Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE.

• Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer.

• Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

What you'll bring

• Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products.

• Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM).

• Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management.

• Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution.

• Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.

• Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems.

• Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities.

Our mission is to empower GitLab system administrators with the toolkit they need to create their desired balance of security and accessibility for their GitLab experience.

Authentication is the first impression a new customer has when they configure a new GitLab instance. We aim to make it as seamless as possible, from that first login to onboarding users and managing security rules for their instance in a secure, flexible, and scalable way.

opportunities.title: AI Tool Admin
opportunities.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

At Elastic, we have a simple goal: to pursue the world's data problems with products that delight and inspire. We help people around the world do extraordinary things with their data. From stock quotes to Twitter streams, Apache logs to WordPress blogs, our products are extending what's possible with data, delivering on the promise that good things come from connecting the dots. Often, what you can do with our products is only limited by what you can dream up. We believe that diversity drives our vibe. We unite employees across 30+ countries into one unified team, while the broader community spans across over 100 countries.

Elastic, makers of the hugely popular open source products Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash, and Beats, is growing very fast and so is our marketing team. As a key member of the Marketing AI, Operations and Automation team, you will play a hands-on, critical role in governing and administering the marketing AI tool stack that teams across the organisation depend on. From configuring tools at the system level to reviewing AI-generated content before it goes live, you will be the operational backbone that keeps marketing AI running consistently, safely, and at scale.

Elastic is looking for a flexible and adaptable person with the ability to manage a variety of governance and administration responsibilities across a growing set of AI tools and platforms. This is an ideal position for a self-motivated individual who has experience administering enterprise marketing technology, is process oriented, and has the ability to work in a fast-paced, distributed environment.

What You Will Be Doing

• Own the AI-level configuration, system prompts, and governance standards for every tool in the approved marketing AI stack, ensuring consistency across the organisation rather than tool-by-tool drift.

• Act as the human review layer for AI-generated content and submissions, serving as the final checkpoint before anything goes live when agents flag warnings.

• Enforce the tool ownership model, ensuring every approved marketing AI tool has a named owner assigned before teams begin using it.

• Maintain the internal prompt library, approved-use guidelines, and minimum starting prompts available to marketers across the organisation.

• Partner with the Marketing AI Engineer to onboard new tools and workflows through the appropriate approval processes.

• Surface tool-level usage patterns and review volume to inform resourcing and governance decisions as the team scales.

• Assist in maintaining internal documentation across team knowledge bases, wikis, and the playbooks.

What You Bring

• 3+ years in a marketing operations or marketing technology role with tool administration responsibilities.

• Hands-on experience working with at least one enterprise AI or generative AI platform at an organisational level, such as Jasper, Writer, or Adobe Firefly.

• Demonstrated understanding of system-level prompt architecture and how AI configuration affects output quality and consistency across teams.

• Strong process orientation with the ability to build governance workflows and documentation standards from scratch.

• Familiarity with Marketo, Workfront, or similar enterprise marketing platforms.

• Clear, precise written communication and strong attention to detail.

• Experience working across globally distributed teams spanning AMER, EMEA, and APJ.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

• Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary

• Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

• Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles

• Generous number of vacation days each year

• Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

opportunities.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is the Role

You are the person a customer calls when their Elasticsearch platform is the problem, or when they need one designed properly the first time.

That means you decide the shape of a cluster and then defend that decision — node topology, shard strategy, data tiers, lifecycle and retention — with the sizing arithmetic to back it up. It also means you can follow a performance problem beyond Elastic itself. We need someone whose instinct is to look down the stack and sideways to whatever else shares the infrastructure, rather than stopping at the cluster API.

What You Will Be Doing

• Design and build Elasticsearch platforms for customers across self-managed, orchestrated and managed deployments, including air-gapped and regulated environments

• Own sizing and capacity planning as a derivation from workload characteristics — ingest rate, document shape, retention, query concurrency, growth — validated by benchmark rather than estimated from a form

• Run health checks and remediation on production estates, and redesign sharding, mapping and index strategies where the original design no longer holds

• Lead major-version upgrades, snapshot and disaster recovery strategy, and multi-cluster architectures

• Diagnose performance problems across the full stack — Elastic, the JVM, the operating system, storage and network — and across adjacent systems in the data path

• Work directly with customer architects, platform owners and engineering leadership; run discovery, present designs, and own the technical outcome of an engagement end to end

• Build reusable tooling, automation and IP that makes the next engagement faster, including AI-assisted tooling for diagnosis, configuration and reporting

• Mentor other consultants and contribute to the GCC's technical practice

What You Bring

Elastic depth — non-negotiable

We are not looking for someone who will learn Elastic on the job.

• 8+ years hands-on with the Elastic Stack, substantially on cluster and platform work rather than dashboarding or pipeline authoring

• Shard strategy you can derive, not recite — how you arrived at a shard count and size for a given workload, what you traded off, and what you got wrong the first time

• Index and mapping design, and why those choices drive cluster performance

• Lifecycle and retention across data tiers, including the cost and latency implications of each

• Snapshot, restore and disaster recovery designed and executed, not just configured

• Major-version upgrades in production — the sequencing, the breaking changes, the rollback position

• More than one deployment model: self-managed plus at least one managed or orchestrated option

• Cluster stability and performance troubleshooting — heap and garbage collection, circuit breakers, thread pool rejections, shard allocation, expensive queries

• Elastic Certified Engineer, or the demonstrable knowledge to obtain it within your first quarter

• Strong Linux and operating system fundamentals, with solid grounding in storage and networking

• A working understanding of how infrastructure conditions translate into Elastic symptoms, and how infrastructure choices constrain what a deployment can do

• Experience troubleshooting on shared infrastructure, where the cause of your problem is another workload's behaviour and resolving it means engaging the team that owns it

opportunities.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Applications Engineer 2

About the job

Twilio is looking for a Salesforce Developer to join the GTM Automation team. This is a great role for an experienced Salesforce developer looking to work more closely with the business, apply their mastery on the Salesforce platform to deliver impact, and expand the breadth of exposure beyond Salesforce. You will be in the unique position of joining a growing development team that you can learn with and help shape.

You are right for this role if you excel at solving multi-faceted problems, managing large volumes of data, and building world-class tools that drive impact. The ideal candidate is able to deeply understand the core business problem being addressed, balance speed and quality, and provide solution alternatives. You are a results-oriented individual who is motivated to tackle complex problems, has a "can do" attitude, and is comfortable asking questions.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

• Work with the GTM Automation Systems team on evolving a Salesforce data model that is technically scalable, easily reportable, and functionally intuitive for end users.

• Utilize SOQL API’s, Apex controllers, Apex Web Services, Apex callouts, and other development tools to build custom functionality that tailors our sales systems to our unique business and operating model.

• Participate in technical analysis activities together and document requirements for application Integration and also involved in integration design activities working with architects and other stakeholders.

• Review and assure quality in all code entering our codebase.

• Continually evaluate and refactor our existing codebase for increased extensibility.

• Ability to learn new technologies depending on project requirements.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

• 3+ years experience with Apex, LWC, SOQL , Javascript with Agile development practices

• Advanced flow development

• API integrations (ETL, marketing tools, ERP, analytics)

• Data architecture support

• Performance optimization and technical debt reduction

• Deployment and CI/CD support

• Security and scalability improvements

• Tech Design Collaboration with System Architect

• Ability to translate technical requirements into independent features for development

• Comprehensive experience on debugging and troubleshooting in Salesforce

• Experience in identifying common blind spots and bugs in Salesforce

• Experience in working with and optimizing millions of rows of data

• Proficiency in developing unit tests with assertions for core functionality

Desired:

• Experience in AgentForce, Einstein, AI tools/technologies

• Experience in SQL, Python, Data Cloud, Snowflake

• Familiarity working with a Pay-as-you-go business model

• Experience developing and deploying through Heroku

Location

This role will be remote, and based in India <Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana State, Maharashtra and New Delhi>.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

This role requires a builder and curious mindset, someone who can bridge the gap across theoretical research, production-grade experimentation and enterprise quality software. You will lead rapid research cycles to solve complex problems regarding contextual intelligence and large scale ML problems ensuring every interaction feels seamless and personalized.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

• Build out new functionality within a fast moving product seeing rapid adoption.

• Take a nebulous idea, design a rigorous experiment, and execute it within weeks.

• Conduct deep-dive research into state-of-the-art LLM orchestration, retrieval strategies, and data-driven personalization.

• Build ML systems that hold up at Twilio scale.

• Rapidly acquire new technical skills and knowledge in a fast-paced, high-delivery environment.

• Proactively leverage and integrate the latest AI development stacks to bypass boilerplate engineering and focus on core differentiation.

Qualifications

• Comfort operating in a 0-to-1 setting with ambiguous requirements and a strong bias for action.

• Proficiency in Python programming language.

• Experience building cloud-based services on AWS, GCP, or Azure, with high-volume data, streaming or real-time inference paths, and a range of data stores.

• Deep expertise in the design, architecture, and deployment of production-grade ML/AI systems, including LLM orchestration, embedding models, and vector stores.

• Strong fundamentals of statistical machine learning algorithms, transformer models, LLMs

• Ability to raise the technical bar of a team through mentorship, design review, and standards, without formal management authority.

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Principal engineer (L5) on Twilio’s Segment, Data Pipelines team.

About the job

As a Principal Engineer on the Twilio Segment Data platform/pipelines team, you won’t just design systems—you will be the design anchor for data platforms that processes hundreds of thousands of data points per second. We are looking for a visionary, deeply inquisitive engineer who has built 0-1 architectures, scaled them to global proportions, and collected the battle scars that come from pushing cloud-native systems to their absolute limits. You will guide our engineering organization through complex distributed design choices, ensuring reliability, performance, and cost-efficiency while querying petabytes of data for the world's leading Customer Data Platform (CDP). If you are naturally curious, obsessed with knowing exactly how systems break under intense load, and eager to pioneer the integration of AI into real-world data processing, this is your ultimate playground.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

• Own the technical north star and deliver robust, highly composable routing experiences for the core Data platform and pipelines at Twilio Segment.

• Design and pioneer always-available, fault-tolerant distributed systems in cloud environments, using past system failures to design out-of-the-box resilience.

• Lead through technical influence, masterfully guiding high-stakes design decisions and articulating the precise trade-offs between cost, performance, and reliability to both engineers and executives.

• Translate complex technical strategies into clear, elegant, and actionable blueprints that align diverse stakeholders, including Product Managers, Architects, and engineering teams.

• Actively prototype and experiment, bringing an inquisitive mindset to the platform by identifying where emerging AI technologies and LLMs can solve systemic data processing challenges.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

• 12+ years of programming experience. Deep battle-tested experience with high-scale messaging/streaming systems and distributed processing engines (handling several thousand events/sec minimum).

• Mastery of high-level service design, with a proven ability to model complex interfaces and internals in a properly modular, composable, and extensible way.

• Expert programming experience in Go or similar concurrent, object-oriented languages, with a sharp eye for performance bottlenecks.

• An active "AI story"—demonstrated, hands-on experience identifying, prototyping, and deploying GenAI/LLM solutions to solve real-world engineering or data processing challenges.

• Profound technical depth in distributed systems, high-scale ingestion, and cutting-edge cloud-native architecture.

• Superb communication and problem-solving skills, with a natural inclination to mentor others and a relentless drive for operational excellence

Desired:

• Advanced proficiency with high-throughput datastores, distributed caching layers, and container orchestrators (Docker/Kubernetes).

• Experience with modern CI/CD pipelines and robust observability frameworks (Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus) to predict and diagnose failures.

• Deep familiarity with broader AI/ML infrastructure and data workflows.

• Hands-on experience managing, optimizing, and operating large-scale AWS cloud infrastructure.

• A proven track record of driving technical alignment and collaboration across a geographically distributed engineering team.

Location

This role will be based in any of the permitted 5 India states (Delhi, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Telangana & TamilNadu)

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

About the job

In this role, you will build the foundational AI/ML capabilities that power intelligent engagement experiences for Twilio customers - letting any application, human or AI agent, or channel know who a customer is, what they have done, and how best to reach them.

This role requires a builder and curious mindset, someone who can bridge the gap across theoretical research, production-grade experimentation and enterprise quality software. You will lead rapid research cycles to solve complex problems regarding contextual intelligence and large scale ML problems ensuring every interaction feels seamless and personalized.
