In this role, you’ll:

• Build out new functionality within a fast moving product seeing rapid adoption.

• Take a nebulous idea, design a rigorous experiment, and execute it within weeks.

• Conduct deep-dive research into state-of-the-art LLM orchestration, retrieval strategies, and data-driven personalization.

• Build ML systems that hold up at Twilio scale.

• Rapidly acquire new technical skills and knowledge in a fast-paced, high-delivery environment.

• Proactively leverage and integrate the latest AI development stacks to bypass boilerplate engineering and focus on core differentiation.

• Comfort operating in a 0-to-1 setting with ambiguous requirements and a strong bias for action.

• Proficiency in Python programming language.

• Experience building cloud-based services on AWS, GCP, or Azure, with high-volume data, streaming or real-time inference paths, and a range of data stores.

• Deep expertise in the design, architecture, and deployment of production-grade ML/AI systems, including LLM orchestration, embedding models, and vector stores.

• Strong fundamentals of statistical machine learning algorithms, transformer models, LLMs

• Ability to raise the technical bar of a team through mentorship, design review, and standards, without formal management authority.

• Experience in building cloud-based services using AWS, GCP, or Azure.

• Strong communication skills and highly effective collaborator who works well with teammates.

Desired:

• Prior experience building autonomous agents that handle multi-turn conversations and maintain long-term context/consistency.

• Strong background in predictive modeling on user behavior, including experiment design and the causal or counterfactual methods needed when randomization is partial.

• Prior experience working in a globally distributed team.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in India - Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana State, Maharashtra and New Delhi.

opportunities.title: Lead Advanced Analytics, Community Support
opportunities.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Analytics Centre of Excellence (ACOE) at Airbnb, based in India, is a hub of knowledge and expertise that aims to provide data-driven decision-making, enabling Airbnb's business goals. The ACOE's vision is to build a world-class analytics organization that provides scalable analytics. We work with various business functions such as payments, trust, digital, customer support, hosting, sales,social, compliance, risk, platforms and partnership & economics.

The ACOE's delivery framework is designed to provide relevant and contextual insights for data-driven decisions. This includes a one-stop solution for metrics, dashboards driving actionable insights, optimization of performance, experimentation, measuring pre/post feature impact, sizing the ROI of opportunities, prioritization of opportunities, anomaly-driven alerting mechanisms, root cause analysis of metric deviation, and exploratory hypothesis testing.

The Difference You Will Make

ACOE is seeking a Lead, Advanced Analytics, Community Support to help Airbnb enable travel for millions of guests and hosts on our platform. This individual will play a pivotal role in supporting strategic business and product initiatives through detailed data analysis, metrics creation, statistical modeling, and the development of reporting tools and metrics. The individual will be instrumental in driving business and product decisions across topic areas across the company.

A Typical Day

• Design and build metrics / dimensions to monitor product and business performance.

• Build sophisticated reporting, analytical tools, and dashboards that empower stakeholders to make data-driven decisions.

• Work cross-functionally with Strategic Finance, Data and Analytical Engineering,and Data Science teams to ensure alignment and leverage synergies.

• Conduct advanced data analysis and statistical modeling to extract actionable insights that inform strategic decisions.

• Contribute towards advancing the Analytics and Data Science disciplines at Airbnb, including driving data best practices such as improving and automating analytical processes, building new data tools and data sets, data education around the company and mentoring and developing others.

• Actively build and scale AI-first analytics capabilities by integrating LLMs, agent-based workflows, and automation into day-to-day analytical processes

• Drive adoption of AI tools across teams by embedding them into business workflows, enabling self-serve analytics and decision support

• Stay at the forefront of applied AI developments and continuously evaluate their relevance for solving business problems

Your Expertise

• 8+ years in industry experience and a degree (Masters or PhD is a plus) in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, Operations Research).

• Prior experience in data science, product analytics within the community support/customer support domain.

• Deep expertise in measurement frameworks, metric design, and metric creation.

• Advanced level proficiency in SQL/NoSQL, programming languages such as Python, R, SAS and Intermediate level knowledge of data foundations and databases like Presto, Hive, Teradata, Spark.

• Expert with BI tools like Tableau or superset to develop reports and dashboards.

• Experience leveraging AI to build dashboards, automate repetitive tasks, and empower stakeholders.

• Familiar with experimentation, causal inference, and LLMs

• Robust business acumen, strategic thinking skills, and the ability to make informed judgments.

• Outstanding communication skills, capable of engaging with a variety of stakeholders and conveying complex concepts in an accessible manner.

• Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to collaborate and influence across functions.

• An agile, growth-minded approach, demonstrated through a history of driving projects from ideation to impact.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

India Annual Pay Range

₹3,080,000 - ₹4,400,000 INR

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

The Community You Will Join:

We are looking for a senior advanced analyst in our India Analytics team who works with the Fraud & Safety Delivery team. The analyst must have functional expertise in building analytical solutions and be a trusted partner to product teams and business leaders, across marketplace teams through providing insights, recommendations, and enabling data driven decisions. This role will sit under the Advanced Analytics family and support Product and Business leaders within our Fraud & Safety organization.

The Difference You Will Make:

• Work with technical and business teams to develop robust insights, create data narratives and leverage Airbnb’s rich data to define metrics.

• Build advanced analytical capabilities and tools, passionate about solving complex problems with data; adding a new perspective to existing solutions and making business decisions based on careful and thoughtful analysis.

• Leverage Airbnb’s state-of-art machine learning infrastructure, and other central data science tools to build and collaborate with a strong team of engineers, product managers, designers and operation agents to achieve shared, cross-functional goals.

• You have a strong sense of urgency for and commitment to Airbnb’s mission of belonging.

• Develop a deep understanding of how guests and hosts interact with our Fraud & Safety frictions and how we can manage our risk while meeting our regulatory compliance requirements, through structured and unstructured data sources.

A Typical Day:

• Execute projects with regular direction; Set a roadmap for projects up to a quarter ahead providing constant updates to business stakeholders, analytics management and deliver against agreed timelines.

• Ensure the availability of data quality and data integrity for analysis and reporting, by blending external and internal data, working closely with global operations and India analytics functions.

• Perform data modeling for the various entities involved in Airbnb including customers, hosts, cases, agents, and others using modern data modeling tools and frameworks to provide the analytical foundation.

• Execute ad-hoc reporting, data investigations, and root cause analysis into various operational areas including policy incubation, enforcement efficacy, prevalence, efficiency, agent tooling, agent staffing & optimization, and agent quality & efficiency to identify and solve for operational bottlenecks and inefficiencies.

• Devise business metric frameworks and optimization models to make optimal business decisions that support arguments for Airbnb’s product, operations and policy issues

• Influence data-driven decisions across global sites and business verticals in day-to-day via business reviews, self-serve portal, planning scorecards, and impact analyses among others.

• Experiment with new Airbnb policy / product features to help deter and mitigate risk

• Influence machine learning models in partnership with DS / Engg teams to automate policy enforcement decisions, while enqueueing the most complex cases for manual review by agents

• 5+ years of industry experience and an Advanced degree in Business Analytics or other (Masters or PhD is a plus) in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, Operations Research).

• Good communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with internal teams in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment. Ability to conduct rigorous analysis and communicate conclusions to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Proven track record of delivering full stack data projects from inception to business impact.

• Advanced level proficiency in SQL/NoSQL, programming languages such as Python, R, SAS and Intermediate level knowledge of data foundations and databases like Presto, Hive, Teradata, Spark.

• Advanced level proficiency in statistical and machine learning techniques, Tableau or similar BI platform to develop reports and dashboards

• Familiarity with EDA, hypothesis testing, significance testing, linear regression, logistic regression, SVM, ridge regression, lasso regression, random forest, basic concepts of NLP, KNN, K-Means, A/B testing, multivariate testing, and digital funnel testing.

• Have a positive and solution-oriented mindset with an ability to maintain confidentiality and objectivity.

• Exceptional problem-solving abilities, self-motivation and ability to work autonomously, strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

• Knowledge and experience in Fraud & Safety operations, systems and tools would be a plus

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

The world is changing how it works; not just in where we do it, but in how fast and how well we can do it. Airbnb has already shown that we can move with speed and intention. We navigated a pandemic, rebuilt our company from the ground up, had a successful IPO, and shipped product upgrades – all while working remotely. That experience didn't just change where we work. It changed what we believe is possible.
Now, a new shift is underway. AI is fundamentally changing the leverage available to every team – compressing timelines, breaking down traditional job description silos, raising the ceiling on quality, and enabling small, focused groups to accomplish what once required much larger ones. At Airbnb, we are not treating AI as a future consideration. We are moving fast to embed it into how we operate today – using it to multiply the impact of every employee, every system, and decisions we make every day. The companies and teams that embrace this shift with urgency and discipline will define what's possible in the years ahead. We intend to be one of them.

The Difference You Will Make:

The Systems Engineer is a hands-on builder who moves fast, delivers with quality, and uses AI as a force multiplier in day-to-day work. In this role, you will configure, maintain, and continuously improve Airbnb's Atlassian platforms, and you will own end-to-end delivery of defined projects within the Jira Data Center deprecation and transition to Jira Cloud. • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting using native Jira Cloud tooling; Airbnb has elected to avoid Atlassian Marketplace products for information security, privacy, and legal reasons. • Support Atlassian access management, user lifecycle management, and license hygiene, and contribute to security posture improvements

• Partner with business stakeholders in requirements-gathering sessions, translate needs into configuration and automation solutions, and proactively highlight issues or risks in the work

• Configure Atlassian Rovo AI agents and automation rules; evaluate trade-offs between delivery speed and long-term sustainability, and apply AI responsibly and in context

• Write and maintain automation rules using Jira's native Automation engine and JavaScript; use the Jira REST API for integrations, data imports, and custom reporting

• Support testing cycles for platform changes and migrations; write and run test scripts, track defects, and ensure a rollback plan is in place before changes ship

• Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, retrospectives, standups) for platform-focused workstreams

• Keep system configurations, runbooks, and knowledge base articles up to date to support operational continuity and self-service

• Participate in the on-call rotation, respond to Atlassian platform incidents, and contribute to post-incident reviews

• Identify and reduce technical debt over time; provide constructive input in design and configuration reviews, and help teammates learn through specific examples and timely feedback

opportunities.title: Senior AI Specialist
opportunities.description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog .

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape what comes next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Job Overview

Coursera is seeking a Senior AI Specialist to own the technical design and delivery of complex AI applications for business and customer needs. You’ll turn ambiguous requirements into production-grade solutions, working across data exploration, experimentation, architecture, implementation, evaluation, and deployment. This is a hands-on senior IC role: you’ll lead architectural decisions independently, build critical components, and resolve difficult problems across models, agents, applications, and data. You’ll partner with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Software Engineers, LLMOps, and forward-deployed teams to deliver solutions within enterprise and customer environments. Your work will establish reusable approaches and technical standards that improve AI quality, reliability, security, and delivery across projects.

About your skills:

AI Systems Architecture — Design end-to-end applied AI solutions, combining models, retrieval, agentic workflows, and application services while balancing quality, scalability, security, and cost.
AI Delivery & Reliability — Build production grade AI components and reliable data workflows, integrating enterprise data, models, and tools into tested, maintainable applications. Define how AI quality is measured and monitored, using evaluation frameworks, agent tracing
Technical Leadership — Own complex technical decisions, lead design and code reviews, AI evals, and guide cross-functional teams from experimentation through validated production deployment.

What you'll be doing

• Own AI solution architecture - Translate ambiguous requirements into robust system designs, service boundaries, data contracts, and implementation plans. Lead build v/s buy decisions and document trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, reliability, security, and cost.

• Architect RAG systems. Design retrieval-augmented generation pipelines using vector databases, sparse and dense retrieval, hybrid search, metadata filtering, and reranking. Define document parsing, chunking, embedding, and indexing strategies.

• Evaluate and fine-tune models . Determine when model adaptation is warranted over prompting or retrieval. Curate training and validation datasets, implement supervised fine-tuning and parameter-efficient techniques such as LoRA, and benchmark against baseline models for task accuracy, safety, latency, and cost.

• Develop AI services and data integrations. Build critical Python/TypeScript services, APIs, and asynchronous workflows. Partner with Data Engineering on ingestion and indexing pipelines, including normalization of customer data, schema validation, incremental updates, lineage, and recovery.

• Build enterprise agentic systems. Develop stateful workflows with task decomposition, planning, multi-step tool use, dynamic tool selection, structured outputs, memory management, and multi-agent orchestration where justified. Build tool and MCP integrations with validated inputs, scoped permissions, and human approval for sensitive actions. Evaluate retrieval and agent quality against defined accuracy and grounding metrics .

• Implement AI security, and governance controls. Implement defenses against prompt injection, sensitive-data leakage, unauthorized tool execution, and retrieval access violations. Contribute threat models, adversarial tests, and evidence for governance reviews. Translate centrally defined policies into application controls for identity, tenant isolation, data residency, retention, and auditability.

• Adapt solutions to enterprise environments. Work with Engineering and forward-deployed teams to implement cloud, hybrid, and customer-controlled deployments.

• AI evaluation and production observability. Define evaluation datasets and measure retrieval quality, groundedness, task completion, tool correctness, latency, and cost. Combine deterministic checks, calibrated LLM-as-judge, and human review. Partner with LLMOps on CI/CD release gates, prompt and model versioning, tracing, and safe rollouts and rollbacks.

• Own technical quality and system reliability. Set and enforce quality standards across the team, with accountability for code quality, maintainability, and production reliability. Lead architecture and code reviews, mentor AI Specialists, and drive root-cause analysis across model, retrieval, application, and data layers. Improve developer productivity through reusable libraries, reference architectures, tooling, and runbooks.

Qualifications

• 6+ years in applied AI, machine learning, or software development, including architecture and production ownership of complex AI systems.

• Experience applying enterprise AI controls , including scoped tool authorization, tenant isolation, PII handling, prompt-injection defenses, audit logging, and human approval for sensitive actions.

• Experience designing enterprise semantic layers or context graphs that connect business entities, relationships, and definitions across systems.

• Strong experience with cloud deployments using GCP/AWS including serverless technologies, CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, Docker and Kubernetes and model platforms such as Vertex AI, Bedrock, etc.

• Familiarity with centralized LLM gateways such as LiteLLM, covering multi-provider routing, fallbacks, rate limits, token budgets, caching, and access policies.

• Production-grade development using Python, TypeScript, and SQL , with typed interfaces, APIs, asynchronous processing, and automated testing.

• Build enterprise agentic systems using LangGraph, Mastra, or equivalent frameworks , including planning, multi-agent orchestration, state and memory management, checkpointing, and failure recovery.

• Applied knowledge of LLM inference and context engineering , including structured outputs, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and evaluation-driven model selection or fine-tuning.

• Practical work with Databricks, Spark, and Postgres , spanning analytical and transactional workloads, batch and real-time pipelines, and normalization of messy customer data.

• AI evaluation using Braintrust or equivalent , including golden datasets, custom scorers, regression testing, and calibrated LLM-as-judge to measure task success, tool correctness, safety, and cost.

• Worked on enterprise AI observability layers , including agent traces, model and tool spans, prompt versions, error attribution, latency, token usage, and cost tracking.

For more information about how Coursera collects and uses your personal information, please see our Coursera + Udemy Global Applicant Privacy Notice .

To protect against recruitment fraud, Coursera + Udemy recruiters only communicate via official coursera.org/udemy.com email addresses and never through personal accounts. We do not accept resumes via email or social media; please submit all applications directly through our careers page.

If you encounter suspicious recruitment activity, please report it via our Fraudulent Activity Submission Form.

Coursera is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a welcoming and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics and provide reasonable accommodations upon request at recruiting@coursera.org.

opportunities.title: Business Technology Engineer II
opportunities.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

In Samsara’s Business Technology Core IT team, we work to deliver awesome systems, support, and experiences that enable our teams to be as impactful as possible. As a member of the team, you’ll help own network technology and processes that enable our people to do their best work. We are responsible for identifying, designing, implementing, and supporting the applications and networks to create a streamlined experience for Samsarians. As a Network/Infrastructure Engineer on the team, you will work alongside our senior network engineers to help maintain, optimize, and troubleshoot our global on-premise network infrastructure, with a particular focus on our Cisco Meraki environment. This is a great opportunity for someone early to mid-career in network engineering to build hands-on expertise while learning from experienced mentors, all while helping ensure high availability and performance for a growing company. You will work closely with operations team members to operate, repair, and improve existing network infrastructure, including providing tier-1 and tier-2 support to other members of the Information Technology team and escalating more complex issues to senior engineers as needed.

This role is based at our Bangalore office and requires on-site presence 2-3 days a week.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role is a launchpad rather than your last stop at Samsara. You’ll work alongside senior network engineers who will mentor you, and we’ve built a culture that encourages rapid career development and countless opportunities to grow your networking craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

Click here to learn about what we value at Samsara.

In this role, you will:

• Configure, install, and maintain network hardware and software components, including Meraki switches, access points, and firewalls, under the guidance of senior network engineers.

• Perform hands-on troubleshooting and issue resolution for day-to-day network incidents, using the Meraki Dashboard, Wireshark, and packet captures to help identify root cause, escalating more complex issues to senior team members.

• Assist in developing and deploying network automation scripts and tools to enhance efficiency, partnering with senior engineers on more advanced automation projects.

• Support network maintenance activities including hardware and software upgrades, migrations, capacity upgrades, and decommissioning.

• Collaborate with other IT team members to integrate network systems with other applications and systems.

• Help build and maintain dashboards and reporting to monitor the health and performance of our network environments.

• Provide technical support and training to end-users as needed.

• Create and update documentation for network designs, best practices, and operational procedures.

• Support hardware lifecycle management, from procurement to decommissioning.

• Assist in system deployment and configuration for new projects or initiatives.

• Partner with vendors and service providers to help procure and maintain hardware and software.

• Participate in duty rotation of 7-day by 24-hour on-call support.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent professional experience.

1-3 years of hands-on experience in network engineering, IT infrastructure, or a related technical role, with exposure to Cisco Meraki hardware. Hands-on familiarity with the Cisco Meraki platform, including configuring VLANs, SSIDs and wireless settings, group policies, and site-to-site VPN (Auto VPN) across MX, MS, and MR devices. Solid understanding of the OSI model and core TCP/IP networking concepts, including routing and switching fundamentals, DHCP, DNS, and QoS/DSCP.

• Ability to troubleshoot common network issues using the Meraki dashboard, packet captures, and tools like Wireshark, digging in before escalating more complex problems to senior engineers.

• Exposure to network monitoring and diagnostic tools (e.g., SolarWinds, LogicMonitor, PRTG, ELK, Meraki dashboard alerts and reporting, or similar).

• Comfortable learning and applying SD-WAN specific features such as firewall and content filtering rules and adaptive policy, with eagerness to grow into more advanced protocols over time.

• Strong documentation habits, including experience creating and maintaining network diagrams using tools like Visio or Lucidchart or similar platforms documentation is a critical part of this role.

• Experience with IT asset and inventory management, tracking network hardware from procurement through deployment and decommissioning.

• Willingness to participate in a rotational on-call schedule, responding to production network incidents outside of standard business hours.

• Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset, partnering with senior network engineers and cross-functional IT teams on incident tickets and SLA-based response and resolution.

An ideal candidate also has one or more:

• Early experience or strong interest in designing, deploying, and operating networks at scale.

• Familiarity with the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence, OpsGenie, StatusPage).

• Familiarity with Splunk or similar log analysis tools.

• Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), or actively working toward it.

• Basic proficiency in API or other scripting/programming languages.

• Familiarity with Google Workspace and Google Cloud Platform.

• Exposure to cloud network management in AWS and/or GCP.

#LI-hybrid

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. opportunities.title: IT Audit Analyst
opportunities.description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com .

The Yext Internal Audit team is a dynamic and growing global team that provides independent assurance and advisory services over technology, security, and operational risk. The IT Audit Analyst is based in Hyderabad, India and reports to the Manager, IT Audit. In this role you will perform operational IT audits across cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, software delivery, AI, third-party risk, and data privacy in a fast-paced, AI-forward SaaS environment. You will work closely with Engineering, Security, and IT partners to evaluate controls and help them understand and operationalize practical, effective controls.

What You'll Do

Audit Execution

• Execute IT audits under the direction of the Manager, including planning, process walkthroughs, risk and control matrix development, test design, fieldwork, and workpaper documentation

• Test controls over cloud and infrastructure environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure), including identity and access management, configuration management, logging and monitoring, and backup and recovery

• Test controls over software development, change and release management, and production access in a DevOps and CI/CD environment

• Assess security controls against frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF, including vulnerability management, incident response, and data protection

• Support third-party/vendor risk and data privacy reviews, including vendor assessments, data flow mapping, and privacy controls (e.g., GDPR, India DPDP Act)

• Support AI governance reviews by helping inventory AI use cases and testing controls over data quality, model lifecycle, access, monitoring, and human oversight

• Use data analytics (e.g., Excel, SQL, Python) and AI tools to test full populations, automate evidence collection, and improve audit efficiency, in line with the team's responsible AI use guidelines

Control Implementation Support and Collaboration

• Partner with control owners to help them understand control requirements, prepare evidence, and operationalize practical controls, while maintaining independence and objectivity (management retains ownership of implementation and remediation)

• Draft clear audit findings, root causes, and recommendations, and track remediation plans through validated closure

• Build strong working relationships and collaborate with Security, Engineering, IT, Legal, and Compliance partners, and with the Internal Audit team in New York across time zones

• Communicate audit status, results, and risks clearly and promptly to the Manager and stakeholders

• Contribute to risk assessments, audit methodology, templates, process improvements, and the GRC/audit management tooling

• Continuously build knowledge of cybersecurity, cloud, and AI risks and emerging technologies, and share learnings with the team

What You Have

• 2-5 years of experience in IT audit, technology risk, cybersecurity, GRC, or a related field; experience in a SaaS, cloud, or technology environment (or Big 4/consulting serving technology clients) a plus

• Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field

• Working knowledge of IT general controls and cybersecurity concepts, including cloud security, identity and access management, network security, encryption, vulnerability management, logging and monitoring, and incident response

• Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and GDPR; exposure to AI risk frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001) a plus

• Ability to understand processes and document them clearly, including flowcharts, control narratives, and testing workpapers

• Proficiency with Excel and data analysis; SQL or Python a plus; curiosity and enthusiasm for applying AI and automation to audit work

• Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills, with comfort working with engineers and non-technical stakeholders across functions, regions, and cultures

• Strong written and oral communication skills

• Strong attention to detail, ownership mindset, and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment

• CISA, Security+, CEH, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or cloud certification (e.g., AWS) preferred, or actively pursuing

Perks and Benefits

At Yext, we take pride in our diverse workforce and prioritize creating an engaged and connected working environment. Our ambitious mission is to transform the enterprise with AI search, and we know that to achieve that, we need a global team of innovators, visionary thought leaders, and enthusiastic collaborators passionate about making a meaningful impact in the world and contributing to an extraordinary culture.

We believe that people do their best when they feel their best — and to feel their best, they must be well-informed, fuelled, and rested. To ensure our employees are at their best, we offer a wide range of benefits and perks, including:

• Performance-Based Compensation : We offer an attractive bonus structure and stock options for eligible positions.

• Comprehensive Leave Package : Our leave package includes Paid Time Off (PTO), Parental Leave, Sick Leave, Casual Leave, Bereavement Leave, National Holidays, and Floating Holidays to ensure a healthy work-life balance.

• Health & Wellness Offerings : We provide medical insurance with 7L coverage , including enhanced parental and outpatient department (OPD) coverage for you, your spouse, two dependent children, and two parents (as applicable and subject to eligibility requirements).

• Relocation Benefits: We offer relocation assistance and an allowance to eligible candidates to help ease your transition.

• World-Class Office & Building Amenities: Our office has a top-notch infrastructure, including gaming rooms, a plush pantry, and breakout areas.

#LI-Onsite

• Experience closing sales, over multiple years, for a software or SaaS business with an Enterprise book of customers (5000+ FTEs), selling to executives

• Demonstrated experience successfully managing complex sales cycles (6 months+)

quizzes.title: JavaScript & TypeScript Engineering Assessment
quizzes.description: Evaluates production-grade TypeScript idioms, async concurrency, type narrowing, and execution context.

questions.question: In the JavaScript event loop, in what order will 'Promise.resolve().then(cb)', 'setTimeout(cb, 0)', and synchronous code execute?
options: setTimeout callback -> Promise microtask -> Synchronous code
Synchronous code -> Promise microtask -> setTimeout macrotask
Synchronous code -> setTimeout macrotask -> Promise microtask
Promise microtask -> Synchronous code -> setTimeout macrotask
questions.explanation: Synchronous code runs to completion on the call stack, after which the microtask queue (Promise callbacks, queueMicrotask) is completely drained before macrotasks (setTimeout, setInterval) execute.

questions.question: How does TypeScript enforce exhaustiveness checking in a discriminated union switch statement?
options: By annotating the default branch with variable assignment to 'never'
By decorating the function with @exhaustive
By declaring all switch cases inside a try...catch block
By casting the input to 'unknown' before checking
questions.explanation: Assigning the unmatched switch variable to a variable of type 'never' in the default branch causes TypeScript to throw a compile-time type error if any union member was unhandled.

questions.question: Which of the following will properly deep clone an object containing nested objects and arrays without losing Date objects or circular references?
options: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obj))
Object.assign({}, obj)
structuredClone(obj)
questions.explanation: The native structuredClone() API performs a structured clone algorithm supporting Dates, Sets, Maps, and cyclical references, unlike JSON serialization.

questions.question: What is the primary difference between Promise.all and Promise.allSettled?
options: Promise.all runs sequentially, whereas Promise.allSettled runs in parallel
Promise.all rejects immediately upon the first rejection, whereas Promise.allSettled waits for all promises to resolve or reject
Promise.all returns an array of status objects, whereas Promise.allSettled returns only raw values
Promise.allSettled is deprecated in modern Node.js runtimes
questions.explanation: Promise.all fast-fails when any promise rejects. Promise.allSettled waits for every promise to settle and provides an array describing the outcome of each.

questions.question: In TypeScript, what is the key benefit of using 'unknown' over 'any'?
options: 'unknown' disables all type checking just like 'any'
'unknown' requires type narrowing or type assertion before operations can be safely performed on the value
'unknown' can only represent primitive types
'unknown' is only valid in server-side Next.js code
questions.explanation: 'unknown' is the type-safe counterpart of 'any'. You cannot access arbitrary properties or invoke methods on an 'unknown' value without narrowing its type first.

quizzes.title: Relational Database Design & Indexing
quizzes.description: Tests knowledge of B-Tree indexing rules, ACID isolation, foreign key constraints, and query plan performance.

questions.question: Given a composite B-Tree index on (department_id, graduation_year, cgpa), which query will NOT be able to utilize this index efficiently?
options: WHERE department_id = 'CSE' AND graduation_year = 2026
WHERE department_id = 'CSE'
WHERE graduation_year = 2026 AND cgpa > 8.0
WHERE department_id = 'CSE' AND graduation_year = 2026 AND cgpa > 8.0
questions.explanation: B-Tree composite indexes require queries to filter on the leading columns (leftmost prefix). A query filtering only on 'graduation_year' skips 'department_id' and cannot use the index tree traversal efficiently.

questions.question: In ACID transaction guarantees, which isolation level prevents Dirty Reads and Non-Repeatable Reads, but allows Phantom Reads in standard ANSI SQL?
options: Read Uncommitted
Read Committed
Repeatable Read
Serializable
questions.explanation: Repeatable Read ensures that any row read during a transaction cannot be modified by another transaction. In traditional ANSI SQL, new rows matching a range query (phantom reads) could still appear unless Serializable is used.

questions.question: Why should you avoid placing an index on a low-cardinality boolean column like 'is_active' in a 1,000,000-row table?
options: Boolean indexes are not supported in modern relational databases
The query optimizer will usually favor a sequential scan because half the rows match anyway
Boolean indexes corrupt database transaction logs
Boolean values cannot be balanced in a B-Tree node
questions.explanation: When a column has low selectivity (cardinality), the query planner calculates that traversing index pages plus random heap lookups is slower than a sequential block scan.

questions.question: What is the key criterion for a database table to satisfy Boyce-Codd Normal Form (BCNF)?
options: It must contain no composite primary keys
For every non-trivial functional dependency X -> Y, X must be a superkey
It must store all array relationships in JSONB columns
It must have exactly one foreign key per table
questions.explanation: BCNF is a stricter version of 3NF where every determinant (left side of any non-trivial functional dependency) must be a superkey of the relation.

questions.question: What is connection pool starvation in database systems?
options: When memory on the database server runs out due to large temp tables
When all available pool connections are held by active or slow queries, causing new requests to queue or timeout
When the database drops network connections after idle timeout
When replication lag prevents secondary replicas from accepting read queries
questions.explanation: Connection starvation happens when web workers acquire database connections and hold them during slow external API calls or unindexed queries, blocking other HTTP requests from obtaining a connection.

quizzes.title: Modern React & Frontend Architecture
quizzes.description: Evaluates React 19 / Next.js App Router patterns, hooks lifecycle, reconciliation, and Core Web Vitals.

questions.question: Why is using array index as a 'key' prop considered an anti-pattern when rendering dynamic lists in React?
options: It causes compile errors in React 19
Reordering or deleting items causes React to misidentify component identities, leading to incorrect state retention and DOM churn
Array indices cannot be cast to strings in JSX
It disables React concurrent memoization completely
questions.explanation: Keys tell React which item is which across renders. When using indices, deleting or reordering shifts index positions, causing React to associate old component instance states with new data items.

questions.question: In Next.js App Router, which file convention defines a fallback UI rendered automatically via React Suspense while route segments load?
options: error.tsx
loading.tsx
skeleton.tsx
page.loading.tsx
questions.explanation: Next.js automatically wraps page components in a React <Suspense fallback={<Loading />}> boundary when a loading.tsx file exists in the route segment folder.

questions.question: How do you avoid race conditions when fetching data inside a client component useEffect hook without an external library?
options: Set the dependency array to [Date.now()]
Use a boolean 'ignore' / 'cancelled' flag in the effect cleanup function to disregard out-of-order resolved promises
Wrap the fetch call in a synchronous while-loop
Declare the effect callback as 'async () => {}'
questions.explanation: By setting `let cancelled = false; return () => { cancelled = true; }`, if inputs change before the previous network call finishes, the previous promise result is discarded safely.

questions.question: In modern CSS Flexbox, why might text truncation ('truncate' / 'text-overflow: ellipsis') fail inside a flex child?
options: Flex children default to 'min-width: auto', which prevents shrinking below content size unless 'min-width: 0' is applied
Ellipsis is only supported in grid layouts
Flex containers cannot have text nodes
The browser requires 'display: inline-flex' for truncation
questions.explanation: By default, flex children have `min-width: auto`, which forbids the child from shrinking smaller than its intrinsic content width. Setting `min-width: 0` allows flex items to shrink and trigger text truncation.

questions.question: Which Core Web Vital measures the time from when the user initiates navigation to when the largest image or text block within the viewport is rendered?
options: Interaction to Next Paint (INP)
Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)
Time to First Byte (TTFB)
questions.explanation: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) measures perceived loading speed and marks the point in the page load timeline when the primary content has likely loaded.

quizzes.title: Python, Pandas & Machine Learning Foundations
quizzes.description: Tests vectorization, EDA, model evaluation metrics, and general machine learning engineering practices.

questions.question: Why is vectorized computation in NumPy and Pandas significantly faster than native Python for-loops over arrays?
options: Vectorized functions execute compiled C/Fortran code in contiguous memory blocks with SIMD hardware instructions and avoid Python GIL overhead per element
NumPy automatically uploads data to an external cloud cluster
Python for-loops convert every number to a string internally
Vectorized code runs exclusively on GPUs
questions.explanation: NumPy arrays are stored in contiguous C memory buffers and vectorized operations execute compiled machine code using CPU SIMD instructions, avoiding dynamic Python type-checking and interpreter overhead on each iteration.

questions.question: In an imbalanced binary fraud detection problem where positive fraud cases are only 0.2% of the dataset, why is standard Accuracy a deceptive metric?
options: Accuracy cannot be calculated on float values
A naive dummy classifier predicting 'Not Fraud' 100% of the time achieves 99.8% accuracy while failing to detect a single fraudulent case
Accuracy requires equal numbers of features and rows
Scikit-learn disallows accuracy on binary targets
questions.explanation: With extreme class imbalance, a model that classifies everything as the majority class has high accuracy but zero recall. Precision-Recall AUC or F1-Score are far more informative.

questions.question: What does it indicate if the training loss continues to decrease steadily while validation loss starts increasing after epoch 12?
options: The model is underfitting the training distribution
The model is overfitting to noise in the training set and losing generalization power
The learning rate is too low
The dataset has zero bias
questions.explanation: Divergence between decreasing training loss and increasing validation loss is the canonical signature of overfitting. Early stopping should halt training at this inflection point.

questions.question: Why should feature scaling parameters (e.g. mean and standard deviation in StandardScaler) be fit ONLY on the training split, and not on the entire dataset?
options: To avoid data leakage from the test set into the model training pipeline
Because test sets cannot contain negative values
Because StandardScaler only accepts 100 rows at a time
To allow the test set to normalize itself independently
questions.explanation: Fitting scalers or imputers on the full dataset leaks test set statistics into the training phase, giving an unrealistically optimistic estimate of true out-of-sample performance.

questions.question: What is the primary difference between standard K-Fold and Stratified K-Fold cross-validation?
options: Stratified K-Fold ensures each fold maintains the same percentage of target class labels as the complete dataset
Stratified K-Fold works only on continuous regression targets
Standard K-Fold is deterministic, while Stratified is random
Stratified K-Fold trains on all folds at the same time
questions.explanation: Stratification preserves class proportions across all cross-validation folds, which is vital for preventing folds with missing or skewed representation of minority classes.
